items.title: Validation and prognostic value of the five-repetition sit-to-stand test in patients with severe exacerbation of COPD.
items.summary: A prospective observational study (n=58) found the 5-repetition sit-to-stand (5STS) test to be correlated with quadriceps force (r=-0.487) and 6-minute walk test (r=-0.415) and to have prognostic value (AUC 0.720) for predicting exacerbation-related readmission within six months in severe COPD patients, with a cut-off of ≥13 seconds.
items.curatedReason: 5STS 测试对于评估慢阻肺急性加重患者的肌肉力量和运动耐量具有不错的相关性，并且可以辅助预测 6 个月内再入院风险。在临床实践中可作为简单、低成本的筛查工具。
items.titleZh: 五次坐站测试在重度慢阻肺急性加重患者中的验证和预后价值
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察研究（n=58）显示，五次坐站测试（5STS）与股四头肌力量（r=-0.487）和六分钟步行测试（r=-0.415）显著相关，并对重度慢阻肺急性加重患者 6 个月内再入院风险具有可接受的预后价值（AUC 0.720），截断值为 ≥13 秒。
items.curatedReasonEn: The 5STS test shows good correlation with muscle strength and exercise tolerance in patients with severe COPD exacerbation and can help predict 6-month readmission risk. It serves as a simple, low-cost screening tool in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心观察性研究，样本量相对较小，可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center observational study with a relatively small sample size, which may introduce selection bias.

items.title:
Clinical and functional outcomes of aquatic plyometrics in adolescent patellofemoral pain syndrome: a dual-arm randomized controlled trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A dual-arm randomized controlled trial (n=56) found that aquatic plyometric exercises significantly reduced pain (p=0.004, η²p=0.14) and improved quadriceps and hamstring peak torque (e.g., quadriceps 120°/s: p=0.006, η²p=0.13) compared to conventional exercises in adolescents with patellofemoral pain syndrome.
items.curatedReason: 青少年髌股疼痛患者若无法负重训练，水上增强式训练可能是个不错的选择。本 RCT 显示其在缓解疼痛 (p=0.004) 和提高股四头肌与蕦绳肌力量 (p=0.006) 上优于传统训练，且能改善功能障碍和生活质量。
items.titleZh: 青少年髌股疼痛综合征患者水上增强式训练的临床和功能结局：一项双臂随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项双臂随机对照试验（n=56）发现，与传统训练相比，水上增强式训练在青少年髌股疼痛综合征患者中显著缓解了疼痛（p=0.004, η²p=0.14），并提高了股四头肌和蕦绳肌的峰值扭矩（如股四头肌120°/s：p=0.006, η²p=0.13）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For adolescents with patellofemoral pain who cannot perform land-based weight-bearing exercises, aquatic plyometrics might be a good option. This RCT shows it to be superior to conventional exercise in pain relief (p=0.004) and increasing quadriceps and hamstring strength (p=0.006), also improving functional disability and quality of life.
items.limitation: 本研究的长期随访结果未知，且未探讨水上增强式训练对高水平运动表现的影响。
items.limitationEn: Long-term follow-up results are unknown, and the study did not explore the impact of aquatic plyometrics on high-level athletic performance.

items.title: Effects of different types of exercise in patients with stroke: a network meta-analysis
items.summary: A network meta-analysis of 52 RCTs (n=2,329) on stroke rehabilitation found whole-body vibration most beneficial for balance (BBS: MD 9.86, 95% CrI 4.78-14.92) with moderate certainty evidence. Aerobic, aerobic+strength, coordinative, and strength training improved walking endurance, but evidence for gait performance, functional mobility, ADL, and lower-extremity motor recovery was less robust or limited.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后不同运动干预的效果因康复目标而异。在平衡方面，全身振动训练（WBV）的证据强度最高（MD 9.86, 95% CrI 4.78-14.92），可考虑作为核心干预。步行耐力可采用有氧、有氧+力量、协调或力量训练。
items.titleZh: 不同类型运动对卒中患者的影响：一项网络 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 52 项 RCT（n=2,329）进行的网络 Meta 分析发现，全身振动训练对卒中康复中的平衡改善效果最显著（BBS：MD 9.86, 95% CrI 4.78-14.92），且证据确定性为中等。有氧运动、有氧加力量训练、协调训练和力量训练均能改善步行耐力，但对步态表现、功能活动度、日常生活活动和下肢运动恢复的证据较弱或有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: The effects of different exercise interventions after stroke vary by rehabilitation goal. For balance, whole-body vibration (WBV) shows the strongest evidence (MD 9.86, 95% CrI 4.78-14.92) and can be considered a core intervention. For walking endurance, aerobic, aerobic+strength, coordinative, or strength training can be used.
items.limitation: 大多数比较证据的确定性较低（25项低确定性，14项极低确定性），且对日常活动和下肢运动恢复的证据有限。
items.limitationEn: Most comparative evidence was of low certainty (25 low, 14 very low certainty), and evidence for activities of daily living and lower-extremity motor recovery remained limited.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Identification and validation of an interpretable machine learning model for predicting peak ACL force during side-cutting maneuvers
items.summary: An interpretable machine learning model (XGBoost) demonstrated high accuracy (R² = 0.929, RMSE = 0.051) in predicting peak anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) force during side-cutting maneuvers in 204 male football and basketball athletes. Key predictive features included knee flexion angle, hamstring-to-quadriceps activation ratio, and hip flexion angle.
items.curatedReason: 对于足球和篮球这类需要侧向切入的运动，ACL 损伤风险评估至关重要。这项观察性研究提示，膝屈曲角、腘绳肌/股四头肌激活比、髋屈曲角这些生物力学参数，可能通过机器学习模型高精度预测 ACL 峰值负荷。虽是观察研究，但它为你在评估运动员 ACL 损伤风险时提供了新的关注点。
items.titleZh: 识别和验证用于预测侧向切入动作期间 ACL 峰值力量的可解释机器学习模型
items.summaryZh: 一项研究开发了可解释的机器学习模型（XGBoost），在 204 名男性足球和篮球运动员的侧向切入动作中，以高精度（R² = 0.929, RMSE = 0.051）预测了前交叉韧带（ACL）的峰值力量。关键预测特征包括膝屈曲角、腘绳肌/股四头肌激活比和髋屈曲角。
items.curatedReasonEn: For sports involving side-cutting maneuvers like football and basketball, ACL injury risk assessment is crucial. This observational study suggests that biomechanical parameters such as knee flexion angle, hamstring-to-quadriceps activation ratio, and hip flexion angle may highly accurately predict peak ACL forces via machine learning. While observational, it offers new focal points for your ACL injury risk assessments in athletes.
items.limitation: 该模型是在男性足球和篮球运动员中开发的，其对其他性别、运动类型或人群的泛化能力尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The model was developed in male football and basketball athletes, and its generalizability to other genders, sports, or populations is unclear.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: A Narrative Review of Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction Graft Choice and Its Influence on Return to Sport
items.summary: A narrative review on ACL reconstruction graft choice and return to sport (RTS) indicates that autografts are associated with higher RTS and lower revision rates than allografts in young, active patients. No single autograft (bone-patellar tendon-bone, hamstring tendon, quadriceps tendon) has established superiority, requiring individualized selection.
items.curatedReason: ACL 重建术后重返运动时，自体移植物优于同种异体移植物，年轻、活跃患者尤其如此。当前没有证据表明某一种自体移植物（髌腱、腘绳肌腱、股四头肌腱）绝对优于其他。你需要根据患者年龄、运动类型和活动水平进行个体化选择。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建移植物选择及其对重返运动影响的叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 一篇关于 ACL 重建移植物选择及重返运动的叙述性综述指出，在年轻、活跃患者中，自体移植物与同种异体移植物相比，具有更高的重返运动率和更低的翻修率。目前没有证据表明某一种自体移植物（骨-髌腱-骨、腘绳肌腱、股四头肌腱）具有绝对优势，需要个体化选择。
items.curatedReasonEn: For return to sport after ACL reconstruction, autografts are superior to allografts, especially in young, active patients. There is currently no evidence to suggest that one autograft (patellar tendon, hamstring tendon, or quadriceps tendon) is definitively superior to others. You should individualize graft selection based on patient age, sport type, and activity level.
items.limitation: 本综述是一篇叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且未进行系统性证据质量评估。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may be subject to selection bias and did not conduct a systematic assessment of evidence quality.

items.title: Does prehabilitation with exercise improve clinical outcomes of arthroscopic modified Broström procedure in patients with chronic lateral ankle instability: a prospective cohort study
items.summary: A prospective cohort study (n=254) found that a 4-week exercise-based prehabilitation program before arthroscopic modified Broström procedure for chronic lateral ankle instability was associated with significantly higher FAOS scores (92.4 vs. 80.0) and greater improvements in functional performance and return to sports time at 24 months, compared to standard care without prehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究提示，对于慢性外侧踝关节不稳（CLAI）患者，术前运动康复（以腓骨肌强化、本体感觉和平衡训练为主）可以改善术后患者报告结局、功能恢复和重返运动时间。但由于并非 RCT，结果仍需随机对照试验进一步验证。
items.titleZh: 运动术前康复是否改善慢性外侧踝关节不稳患者关节镜下改良 Broström 手术的临床结局：一项前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性队列研究（n=254）发现，对于慢性外侧踝关节不稳患者，在关节镜下改良 Broström 手术前进行为期 4 周的运动术前康复计划，与未进行术前康复的标准护理相比，在 24 个月时患者报告的 FAOS 评分显著更高（92.4 vs. 80.0），功能表现和重返运动时间也有更大改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study suggests that for chronic lateral ankle instability (CLAI) patients, preoperative exercise prehabilitation (focused on peroneal strengthening, proprioception, and balance training) can improve postoperative patient-reported outcomes, functional recovery, and return-to-sport time. However, as it's not an RCT, the results require further validation through randomized controlled trials.
items.limitation: 这是一项非随机前瞻性队列研究，可能存在选择偏倚和混杂因素，无法确定因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was a non-randomized prospective cohort study, which may be subject to selection bias and confounding factors, thus causality cannot be established.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Here are the Speech Language Therapy Coding Changes Going Into Effect on January 1, 2027
items.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, CPT code 92507 for individual speech-language therapy will be replaced by ten new, more specific codes covering fluency, speech sound production, language, and voice/upper airway disorders, as detailed by the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association (ASHA).
items.curatedReason: 虽然这些语言治疗编码变更不直接影响物理治疗，但它们反映了 CMS 在精细化服务分类上的趋势。这提示你，未来物理治疗的 CPT 编码也可能走向更具体的按疾病或干预类型细分，你需要保持关注。
items.titleZh: 2027 年 1 月 1 日生效的语言治疗编码变更
items.summaryZh: 根据美国言语-语言-听力协会（ASHA）的详细说明，自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起，用于个人言语-语言治疗的 CPT 代码 92507 将被十个新的、更具体的代码取代，涵盖流利度、语音生成、语言以及声音/上气道疾病。
items.curatedReasonEn: While these speech therapy coding changes do not directly affect physical therapy, they reflect CMS's trend toward more granular service classification. This indicates that future CPT codes for physical therapy may also move towards more specific breakdowns by disease or intervention type, which you should monitor.

items.title: Diagnostic accuracy and discriminative validity of clinician-administered physiotherapy examination tests in adults with nonspecific neck pain: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review of 18 studies found that clinician-administered physiotherapy examination tests can characterize impairment patterns in adults with nonspecific neck pain, particularly in sensorimotor, muscle performance, and movement-control domains. However, direct clinical diagnostic accuracy evidence is lacking, with most evidence from known-groups comparisons rather than diagnostic uncertainty samples.
items.curatedReason: 临床上，你使用的颈痛体格检查测试更多是用来表征患者的受损模式（如感觉运动、肌肉表现、运动控制），而非直接诊断非特异性颈痛。在将这些测试作为独立诊断工具时，需保持谨慎。
items.titleZh: 临床物理治疗检查测试在非特异性颈痛成人中的诊断准确性和鉴别有效性：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 18 项研究的系统综述发现，临床物理治疗检查测试可用于表征非特异性颈痛成人患者的受损模式，特别是在感觉运动、肌肉表现和运动控制领域。然而，缺乏直接的临床诊断准确性证据，大多数证据来自已知组间比较而非诊断不确定性样本。
items.curatedReasonEn: In clinical practice, the physical examination tests you use for neck pain are more for characterizing impairment patterns (e.g., sensorimotor, muscle performance, movement control) rather than directly diagnosing nonspecific neck pain. Exercise caution when interpreting these tests as standalone diagnostic tools.
items.limitation: 现有研究大多为非特异性颈痛患者与无症状对照组之间的比较，缺乏直接评估临床诊断准确性的研究。
items.limitationEn: Most current studies compare individuals with nonspecific neck pain to asymptomatic controls, lacking studies that directly evaluate clinical diagnostic accuracy.

items.title: Pelvic Floor Knowledge, Toileting Behaviors, and Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms in Women with Multiple Sclerosis
items.summary: A cross-sectional study found women with multiple sclerosis had higher Urogenital Distress Inventory-6 scores (LUTS), lower pelvic floor health knowledge, and more negative toileting behaviors compared to demographically matched women without MS. Premature voiding and straining were significant predictors of LUTS severity.
items.curatedReason: 多发性硬化症（MS）女性患者的下尿路症状（LUTS）发生率更高，且如厕行为（如过早排尿、排便时用力）更消极。作为物理治疗师，你需要关注这些 LUTS 症状和行为模式，将它们纳入 MS 患者的康复评估与管理。
items.titleZh: 多发性硬化症女性患者的盆底知识、排便行为和下尿路症状
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究发现，与年龄匹配的非 MS 女性相比，多发性硬化症女性患者的泌尿生殖道症状评估（LUTS）得分更高，盆底健康知识水平较低，且排便行为更消极。过早排尿和排便时用力是 LUTS 严重程度的重要预测因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: Women with Multiple Sclerosis (MS) experience higher rates of lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) and exhibit more negative toileting behaviors (e.g., premature voiding, straining). As a physical therapist, you need to pay attention to these LUTS and behavioral patterns, incorporating them into MS patient rehabilitation assessment and management.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This study is a cross-sectional design, making it unable to establish causality and potentially subject to recall bias.

items.title: Value-Based Care: APTA Resources to Help You Prepare
items.summary: The American Physical Therapy Association (APTA) has updated its resources to help members navigate value-based care models, understand payment mechanisms, and effectively communicate the value of physical therapist services to payers.
items.curatedReason: 价值导向型医疗模式已是行业大势，你必须了解其运作方式。APTA 的这些最新资源是应对当前支付模式转变的实用起点，建议你利用它们来更新知识、评估潜在协议，并更好地向支付方阐述我们物理治疗服务的价值。
items.titleZh: 价值导向型医疗：APTA 资源助你做好准备
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会（APTA）更新了其资源，旨在帮助会员掌握价值导向型医疗模式、理解支付机制，并有效地向支付方传达物理治疗服务的价值。
items.curatedReasonEn: Value-based care models are the industry's future, and you must understand how they operate. These updated APTA resources are a practical starting point for navigating current payment model shifts. Use them to update your knowledge, evaluate potential agreements, and better articulate the value of our physical therapy services to payers.

items.title: Keeping Pace in a Changing Healthcare Landscape
items.summary: In a competitive healthcare landscape, physical therapy practices must adapt to meet evolving patient demands for convenience and certainty, provider needs for efficient documentation tools, and billing team requirements for better claims management to ensure stable growth.
items.curatedReason: 医疗健康行业竞争日益激烈，病人、支付方和提供者对物理治疗诊所的要求也随之增加。你作为物理治疗专业人员，需要关注如何通过提供便捷的服务、高效的文书工作和智能的计费管理来满足这些不断变化的需求，同时确保业务稳定增长。
items.titleZh: 在不断变化的医疗格局中保持领先
items.summaryZh: 在竞争日益激烈的医疗环境中，物理治疗诊所必须适应以满足患者对便利性和确定性不断变化的需求、提供者对高效文书工具的需求以及账单团队对更好索赔管理的要求，以确保稳定增长。
items.curatedReasonEn: The healthcare industry is increasingly competitive, with rising demands on physical therapy clinics from patients, payers, and providers alike. As a physical therapy professional, you need to focus on how to meet these evolving needs—through convenient services, efficient documentation, and intelligent billing management—while ensuring stable business growth.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Man fined after treating patients, making TV appearance while suspended
items.summary: A New South Wales man was convicted and fined A$6,000 for falsely holding himself out as a registered podiatrist while his registration was suspended, after treating patients and appearing on TV. The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) urged media and the public to check its national register for practitioner status.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚一名吊销执照的足病医生因冒充注册医疗从业者而被判罚款 6000 澳元。这起事件再次提醒你，务必通过 AHPRA 的国家注册系统核实任何声称是注册从业者的人员资质，以维护职业声誉和公众信任。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局：男子在被停职期间治疗患者并上电视节目后被罚款
items.summaryZh: 一名新南威尔士州男子因在注册被吊销期间冒充注册足病医生，治疗患者并出现在电视节目中，被判有罪并罚款 6000 澳元。澳大利亚健康从业者监管局（AHPRA）呼吁媒体和公众通过其国家注册系统核实从业人员的资质。
items.curatedReasonEn: An Australian podiatrist whose registration was suspended was fined A$6,000 for falsely presenting himself as a registered health practitioner. This incident serves as a reminder for you to always verify the credentials of anyone claiming to be a registered practitioner through the AHPRA national register, to uphold professional integrity and public trust.

items.title: Effectiveness of Kalevala Manual Therapy, Health Coaching, and Physiotherapy for Chronic Low Back Pain: A Randomized Controlled Trial (The INTEGRA Trial)
items.summary: A three-arm RCT (n=81) compared physiotherapy, Kalevala Manual Therapy (KMT), and KMT with health coaching (KMT+HC) for chronic low back pain. KMT and KMT+HC yielded comparable improvements in pain and functional disability to physiotherapy, while KMT+HC significantly reduced work-related fear-avoidance beliefs.
items.curatedReason: Kalevala 手法治疗（KMT）及其结合健康指导（KMT+HC）在慢性腰痛（CLBP）患者中的疼痛和功能障碍改善效果与循证物理治疗（PT）相当。KMT+HC 额外显著降低了与工作相关的恐惧-回避信念，提示对行为支持的整合是 CLBP 康复的有效路径。
items.titleZh: Kalevala 手法治疗、健康指导和物理治疗对慢性腰痛的疗效：一项随机对照试验（INTEGRA 试验）
items.summaryZh: 一项三臂随机对照试验（n=81）比较了物理治疗、Kalevala 手法治疗（KMT）以及 KMT 加健康指导（KMT+HC）对慢性腰痛的疗效。研究发现，KMT 和 KMT+HC 在疼痛和功能障碍方面的改善效果与物理治疗相当，且 KMT+HC 显著降低了与工作相关的恐惧-回避信念。
items.curatedReasonEn: Kalevala Manual Therapy (KMT) and KMT combined with health coaching (KMT+HC) offer comparable improvements in pain and disability for chronic low back pain (CLBP) to guideline-based physiotherapy (PT). KMT+HC also significantly reduced work-related fear-avoidance beliefs, suggesting that integrating behavioral support is an effective pathway for CLBP rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 该研究为单中心试验，样本量相对较小（81 例），且存在潜在选择偏倚，可能影响结果的普遍适用性。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center trial with a relatively small sample size (81 participants), and potential selection bias may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Photobiomodulation therapy has a negligible effect as an adjunct to motor control exercise in people with chronic non-specific low back pain: a randomised trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (N=148) found that adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to motor control exercise (MCE) had a negligible effect on pain intensity (MD -0.4 points, 95% CI -1.2 to 0.4), disability (MD -0.7 points, 95% CI -2.4 to 0.9), or circulating PGE2 concentrations compared with sham PBMT plus MCE in adults with chronic non-specific low back pain.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 明确表明，光生物调节疗法 (PBMT) 在运动控制练习 (MCE) 基础上对慢性非特异性腰痛的疼痛强度、残疾或 PGE2 水平没有额外临床重要改善。继续以运动疗法作为核心，PBMT 不该被视为 MCE 的有效辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 光生物调节疗法作为运动控制练习辅助手段对慢性非特异性腰痛患者效果可忽略：一项随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（N=148）发现，在慢性非特异性腰痛成人患者中，与安慰性光生物调节疗法 (PBMT) 加运动控制练习 (MCE) 相比，额外增加主动 PBMT 对疼痛强度（MD -0.4 点，95% CI -1.2 至 0.4）、残疾（MD -0.7 点，95% CI -2.4 至 0.9）或循环 PGE2 浓度没有临床重要改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT clearly indicates that photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) provides no additional clinically important improvements in pain intensity, disability, or PGE2 levels for chronic non-specific low back pain when added to motor control exercise (MCE). Continue prioritizing exercise therapy as the core intervention; PBMT should not be considered an effective adjunct to MCE.
items.limitation: 研究关注的是 PBMT 作为 MCE 辅助疗法的效果，而非单独使用 PBMT 的效果。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on the effect of PBMT as an adjunct to MCE, not on PBMT used in isolation.

items.title: Trajectories of physical activity following digital education and exercise therapy-a longitudinal registry study among 15,197 persons with knee or hip osteoarthritis.
items.summary: A longitudinal registry study of 15,197 individuals with knee or hip OA found that recommended physical activity levels rose from 51.4% at enrollment to 58.5% at one year following a digital education and exercise therapy program. Four distinct PA trajectories were identified, with BMI and physical function being key associated factors. All PA trajectories experienced clinically comparable improvements in patient-reported outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项大型注册研究提示，针对 BMI 较高和功能较差的骨关节炎患者，实施有针对性的策略可更有效地促进其体力活动。同时，无论基线活动水平如何，教育和运动疗法均能带来类似的患者报告结局改善。
items.titleZh: 数字化教育和运动疗法后膝/髋骨关节炎患者体力活动轨迹：一项对 15,197 人的纵向注册研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 15,197 名膝关节或髋关节骨关节炎患者的纵向注册研究显示，在数字化教育和运动疗法项目后，达到推荐体力活动水平的比例从入组时的 51.4% 上升到一年时的 58.5%。研究识别出四种体力活动轨迹，其中 BMI 和身体功能是主要相关因素。所有轨迹的患者报告结局均有临床上可比的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large registry study suggests targeted strategies for OA patients with higher BMI and poorer function may more effectively promote physical activity. Meanwhile, education and exercise therapy provide comparable improvements in patient-reported outcomes regardless of baseline activity levels.
items.limitation: 研究为观察性，无法确立因果关系，且体力活动水平依赖于自我报告。
items.limitationEn: The study is observational, preventing causal inference, and physical activity levels relied on self-report.

items.title: The Current State of Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: Graft Selection, Lateral Augmentation, Rehabilitation, and Return-to-Play.
items.summary: A review of anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR) highlights shifts in graft utilization (quadriceps tendon autograft now ~20% of primary reconstructions by 2023) and the role of lateral extra-articular tenodesis for high-risk knees. Return-to-play practices have moved towards criteria-based clearance, with psychological readiness identified as an independent factor for both return to sport and second ACL injury.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述总结了 ACLR 在移植物选择、外侧加强、康复和重返赛场方面的最新进展。移植物选择应个性化，外侧加强仅限于高风险膝关节，而重返赛场则需综合考量时间、功能标准和心理准备，强调了功能恢复的复杂性和心理因素的重要性。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建的现状：移植物选择、外侧加强、康复和重返赛场
items.summaryZh: 一篇关于前交叉韧带重建 (ACLR) 的综述指出，移植物使用已发生转变（股四头肌腱自体移植物在 2023 年已占初次重建的约 20%），并强调了外侧关节外腱固定术对高风险膝关节的作用。重返赛场实践已转向基于标准的评估，心理准备被认为是重返运动和二次 ACL 损伤的独立相关因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review summarizes current advancements in ACLR regarding graft selection, lateral augmentation, rehabilitation, and return-to-play. Graft selection should be individualized, lateral augmentation reserved for high-risk knees, and return-to-play determined by a combination of time, functional criteria, and psychological readiness, highlighting the complexity of functional recovery and the importance of psychological factors.
items.limitation: 作为一篇综述，其证据级别低于系统综述或荟萃分析，结论可能受作者主观选择影响。
items.limitationEn: As a review, its evidence level is lower than a systematic review or meta-analysis, and conclusions may be influenced by author selection bias.

items.title: Fall prevention interventions among older adults in low-and middle-income countries (LMICs): an integrative review.
items.summary: An integrative review of 14 studies from seven low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) found that multifactorial interventions, exercise-based programs, and home safety modifications were associated with reductions in fall incidence, fall risk, and fear of falling among older adults. However, evidence on contextual adaptation, scalability, and long-term sustainability remains limited.
items.curatedReason: 这项综述发现，在资源有限国家，跌倒干预措施（多因素、运动和家庭安全改造）可能减少老年人跌倒、跌倒风险和跌倒恐惧。但鉴于证据有限，推广前需仔细考量干预措施的在地化适应、可扩展性和长期可持续性。
items.titleZh: 中低收入国家老年人跌倒预防干预措施：一项整合性综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对来自七个中低收入国家 (LMICs) 的 14 项研究的整合性综述发现，多因素干预、基于运动的项目和家庭安全改造与老年人跌倒发生率、跌倒风险和跌倒恐惧的降低相关。然而，关于其情境适应、可扩展性和长期可持续性的证据仍然有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review finds that fall prevention interventions (multifactorial, exercise, and home safety modifications) may reduce falls, fall risk, and fear of falling among older adults in LMICs. However, given limited evidence, careful consideration of contextual adaptation, scalability, and long-term sustainability is needed before widespread implementation.
items.limitation: 纳入研究数量有限且干预措施和结局测量存在差异，限制了结论的普遍性和确定性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included studies and variations in interventions and outcome measures restrict the generalizability and certainty of the conclusions.

items.title: Efficacy of Neuromuscular Electrical Stimulation (NMES) on Lower Limb Mobility and Activities of Daily Living in Post-Stroke Patients: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 10 RCTs (579 patients) found that neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) significantly improved Fugl-Meyer Assessment (MD=3.40, P=0.001), ankle dorsiflexion ROM (MD=1.56, P=0.04), TUG (MD=-1.96, P=0.03), BBS (MD=10.78, P=0.005), PASS (MD=5.05, P<0.00001), and MBI (MD=13.29, P=0.02) in post-stroke patients.
items.curatedReason: 这项荟萃分析提供了强有力的证据，证实神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）能有效改善卒中后患者的下肢功能和日常生活活动能力。当与常规康复结合时，NMES 是值得考虑的辅助干预手段。
items.titleZh: 神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）对卒中后患者下肢活动能力和日常生活活动的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 10 项随机对照试验（579 名患者）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）显著改善了卒中后患者的 Fugl-Meyer 评估（MD=3.40, P=0.001）、踝关节背屈活动度（MD=1.56, P=0.04）、TUG（MD=-1.96, P=0.03）、BBS（MD=10.78, P=0.005）、PASS（MD=5.05, P<0.00001）和 MBI（MD=13.29, P=0.02）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-analysis provides strong evidence that neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) effectively improves lower limb function and activities of daily living in post-stroke patients. When combined with standard rehabilitation, NMES is a worthwhile adjunctive intervention to consider.
items.limitation: 纳入研究存在一定的异质性，可能影响结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: Some heterogeneity exists among the included studies, which may affect the generalizability of the results.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Measurement properties of observational gait analysis tools in neurological disorders: a COSMIN meta-analysis.
items.summary: A COSMIN systematic review and meta-analysis of 28 articles found no observational gait analysis tool was fully recommended for use in neurological populations, but the Wisconsin Gait Scale (WGS) and Gait Assessment and Intervention Tool (G.A.I.T.) showed the best potential for recommendation in stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这项 COSMIN 系统综述提示，在神经疾病人群中，没有观察性步态分析工具被完全推荐使用，但威斯康星步态量表（WGS）和步态评估与干预工具（G.A.I.T）在卒中患者中显示出最佳潜力。评估卒中患者步态时，你可以考虑将 WGS 和 G.A.I.T. 与客观测量结合使用，尤其是在资源受限的环境中。
items.titleZh: 神经系统疾病患者观察性步态分析工具的测量特性：COSMIN 荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 28 篇文章进行的 COSMIN 系统综述和荟萃分析发现，在神经系统疾病人群中，没有观察性步态分析工具被完全推荐使用，但威斯康星步态量表（WGS）和步态评估与干预工具（G.A.I.T.）在卒中患者中显示出最佳推荐潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This COSMIN systematic review indicates that no observational gait analysis tool is fully recommended for use in neurological populations, but the Wisconsin Gait Scale (WGS) and Gait Assessment and Intervention Tool (G.A.I.T) show the best potential in stroke patients. When assessing gait in stroke patients, you may consider combining WGS and G.A.I.T. with objective measurements, especially in resource-limited settings.
items.limitation: 综述中的工具多数研究受限，且均存在较大测量误差，无法进行个体水平或纵向分析。
items.limitationEn: Most tools in the review had limited studies and large measurement error, making them unsuitable for individual-level or longitudinal analysis.

items.title: Balance confidence, balance, and gait capacity in chronic stroke: baseline and change correlations.
items.summary: A secondary analysis of 168 independently ambulant adults with chronic stroke found small, non-significant correlations between Activities-specific Balance Confidence (ABC) scores and objective balance and gait measures at baseline and over time, supporting their assessment as complementary outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对慢性卒中患者的次级分析提示，平衡信心与客观平衡及步态能力之间的关联较弱。继续将主观信心和客观能力作为互补的评估指标，而非互相替代。
items.titleZh: 慢性卒中患者的平衡信心、平衡能力和步态能力：基线及变化相关性。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 168 名慢性卒中患者的次级分析发现，活动特异性平衡信心量表（ABC）评分与客观平衡及步态测量值在基线和随访期间的相关性较小且不显著，支持将其作为互补结局进行评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: This secondary analysis of chronic stroke patients suggests a weak coupling between balance confidence and objective balance and gait capacity. Continue to assess perceived confidence and objective capacity as complementary outcomes, rather than substitutes.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心随机试验的次级分析，可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a secondary analysis of a single-center randomized trial, which may be subject to selection bias.

items.title: Investigating the Feasibility of Locomotor Training for Children Under 5 Years With Complex Neurodisabilties.
items.summary: A single-group pre-post study of 71 children (mean age = 2.8 years) with neurodisabilities found a 6-week locomotor training program feasible and beneficial, with Goal Attainment Scaling scores increasing from 12.8 to 56.2 (85% achieving goals) and mobility outcomes exceeding clinically meaningful thresholds.
items.curatedReason: 这项可行性研究表明，运动训练对 5 岁以下伴复杂神经功能障碍的儿童是可行且有益的，尤其是在目标达成和移动能力方面有显著改善。这为你在临床上考虑早期干预的运动训练提供了初步支持。
items.titleZh: 探讨 5 岁以下复杂神经功能障碍儿童运动训练的可行性。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 71 名（平均年龄 2.8 岁）神经功能障碍儿童的单组前后研究发现，为期 6 周的运动训练项目是可行且有益的，目标达成量表评分从 12.8 增至 56.2（85% 达成目标），移动能力结果超出临床意义阈值。
items.curatedReasonEn: This feasibility study suggests that locomotor training is feasible and beneficial for children under 5 with complex neurodisabilities, showing significant improvements in goal attainment and mobility. This offers preliminary support for you to consider early intervention locomotor training in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 这是一项单组前瞻性研究，缺乏对照组，无法排除自然病程的影响。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-group pre-post study, lacking a control group, which cannot rule out the influence of natural course.
items.journal: Pediatric physical therapy : the official publication of the Section on Pediatrics of the American Physical Therapy Association

items.title: Identifying activities and participation domains with severe dependence using the ICF-based LIMOS-Br in chronic stroke.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 100 chronic stroke individuals found discrepancies between the prevalence and severity of activity and participation limitations using LIMOS-Br, with fine hand use, complex domestic tasks, and community mobility showing the highest frequency of severe dependence.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对慢性卒中患者的研究指出，活动和参与受限的发生频率不一定反映依赖的严重程度。你在评估功能和制定康复计划时，应同时考虑依赖的频率和严重程度，特别关注精细手功能、复杂家务活动和社区移动能力。
items.titleZh: 使用基于 ICF 的 LIMOS-Br 识别慢性卒中患者重度依赖的活动和参与领域。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 100 名慢性卒中患者的横断面研究，使用基于 ICF 的 LIMOS-Br 发现，活动和参与受限的发生频率与严重程度存在差异，其中精细手功能、复杂家务活动和社区移动能力显示出重度依赖的最高频率。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study on chronic stroke patients indicates that the frequency of activity and participation limitations does not necessarily reflect the severity of dependence. When assessing function and planning rehabilitation, you should consider both the frequency and severity of dependence, with particular attention to fine hand use, complex domestic activities, and community mobility.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且样本量相对较小。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which cannot establish causality and has a relatively small sample size.

items.title: Technical and clinical feasibility of a pulmonary telerehabilitation model for people with COPD.
items.summary: A two-phase feasibility study found that connected devices accurately monitored patients (≥99% clinical agreement) during pulmonary telerehabilitation, and an 8-week home-based program was feasible with high patient satisfaction and usability. Endurance time increased by a median of 171 seconds (95% CI 17-725).
items.curatedReason: 这项可行性研究表明，家庭肺康复计划结合数字监测设备在技术和临床上都可行，且患者接受度高。虽然不是改变实践的证据，但它为未来大规模 RCT 铺平了道路，提示远程康复的潜力。
items.titleZh: COPD 患者肺康复远程医疗模式的技术和临床可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项两阶段可行性研究发现，互联设备能准确监测肺康复远程医疗患者（临床一致性≥99%），且为期 8 周的居家项目可行性高，患者满意度和依从性良好。耐力时间中位数增加了 171 秒（95% CI 17-725）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This feasibility study suggests that home-based pulmonary rehabilitation with digital monitoring is both technically and clinically feasible, with high patient acceptance. While not practice-changing evidence, it paves the way for future large-scale RCTs, indicating the potential of telerehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项前瞻性可行性研究，样本量小，且未设对照组，因此不能得出临床疗效的确定性结论。
items.limitationEn: This was a prospective feasibility study with a small sample size and no control group, preventing definitive conclusions on clinical efficacy.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Upright Participation for Learners with Physical Disabilities: A Pilot Randomized Crossover Effectiveness-Implementation Trial of Robot-assisted Walking in Schools
items.summary: A pilot randomized crossover trial found that robot-assisted walking in schools was feasible, with devices used 2.1 to 4.3 days/week for 48 to 96 minutes/week. Preliminary data showed a mean COPM performance change of 3.56 (SD 1.07) for robot-assisted walking versus 2.11 (SD 2.41) for control, suggesting potential effectiveness for children with physical disabilities.
items.curatedReason: 这项试点研究为在学校环境中实施机器人辅助行走提供了初步可行性证据，并提示其可能改善儿童身体和社交参与。鉴于其试点性质，别急于将其作为常规干预，但可以关注后续的明确性试验。
items.titleZh: 肢体残疾学生直立参与：学校中机器人辅助行走的试点随机交叉效应-实施试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对神经发育性肢体残疾儿童的试点随机交叉试验发现，学校实施机器人辅助行走可行，设备每周使用 2.1 至 4.3 天，每次 48 至 96 分钟。初步数据显示，机器人辅助行走的 COPM 表现平均变化为 3.56（SD 1.07），对照组为 2.11（SD 2.41），提示其对肢体残疾儿童的潜在益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study provides preliminary feasibility evidence for implementing robot-assisted walking in schools and suggests its potential to improve physical and social participation for children. Given its pilot nature, avoid integrating it as a routine intervention yet, but monitor for definitive future trials.
items.limitation: 这是一项试点研究，样本量小，主要目的是评估可行性，其效果量估算仅为初步结果。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot study with a small sample size, primarily evaluating feasibility; effect size estimations are preliminary.

items.title: Effectiveness of Wobble Board and Swiss Ball exercises on balance, mobility and functional independence in patients with diabetic peripheral neuropathy
items.summary: A study with 200 DPN patients (45-70 years) found both Wobble Board and Swiss Ball exercises, combined with conventional therapy, significantly improved Berg Balance Scale, Timed Up and Go, and Functional Independence Measure scores (all p < 0.001) after 8 weeks. The Swiss Ball group demonstrated statistically greater improvements across all outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 瑞士球和晃动板锻炼联合常规疗法都能改善糖尿病周围神经病变患者的平衡、活动能力和功能独立性，但瑞士球组的改善更为显著。在为 DPN 患者选择不稳定表面训练时，可以优先考虑瑞士球。
items.titleZh: 晃动板和瑞士球锻炼对糖尿病周围神经病变患者平衡、活动能力和功能独立性的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 200 名 DPN 患者（45-70 岁）的研究发现，晃动板和瑞士球锻炼（均结合常规疗法）在 8 周后均显著改善了 Berg 平衡量表、计时起立行走测试和功能独立性测量评分（均 p < 0.001）。其中，瑞士球组在所有结局指标上均表现出统计学上更大的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Both Swiss Ball and Wobble Board exercises combined with conventional therapy improved balance, mobility, and functional independence in patients with diabetic peripheral neuropathy (DPN), but the Swiss Ball group showed statistically greater improvements. When choosing unstable surface training for DPN patients, you might prioritize the Swiss Ball.
items.limitation: 该研究结果主要基于统计学显著性，未评估临床最小重要差异 (MCID)，且所有患者均接受了常规疗法，无法单独评估晃动板或瑞士球的独立效应。
items.limitationEn: The study's findings are primarily based on statistical significance without evaluating Minimum Clinically Important Differences (MCID); all patients received conventional therapy, preventing independent assessment of Wobble Board or Swiss Ball effects.
items.journal: Bulletin of Faculty of Physical Therapy

items.title: Low balance confidence in relation to strength training, walking, sitting, and physical function among women aged 75–105 years: a cross-sectional study within the Women’s Health Initiative Strong and Healthy (WHISH) Intervention Cohort
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 8,916 women aged 75–105 years in the WHISH cohort found that strength training ≥2 h/week (PR=0.76, 95% CI: 0.71–0.81) and walking ≥4.25 h/week (PR=0.41, 95% CI: 0.37–0.45) were associated with a lower prevalence of low balance confidence (<67% on ABC Scale). Conversely, sitting ≥8 h/day was associated with a higher prevalence (PR=1.24, 95% CI: 1.17–1.32).
items.curatedReason: 这项针对 75 岁及以上老年女性的横断面研究显示，更多的力量训练和步行、更少的久坐时间与更高的平衡信心强烈相关。这为你的老年患者跌倒预防方案提供了重要佐证：积极生活方式，特别是力量训练和步行，是改善平衡信心的关键。
items.titleZh: 75-105 岁女性平衡信心不足与力量训练、步行、久坐和身体功能的关系：WHISH 干预队列的横断面研究
items.summaryZh: WHISH 队列中一项针对 8,916 名 75-105 岁女性的横断面研究发现，每周力量训练 ≥2 小时 (PR=0.76) 和每周步行 ≥4.25 小时 (PR=0.41) 与较低的平衡信心不足（ABC 量表评分 <67%）患病率相关。相反，每天久坐 ≥8 小时则与较高的平衡信心不足患病率相关 (PR=1.24)。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study in women aged ≥75 years demonstrated strong associations between more strength training and walking, less sitting time, and higher balance confidence. This provides crucial support for your fall prevention programs in older adults: an active lifestyle, particularly strength training and walking, is key to improving balance confidence.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法确立因果关系，需纵向研究进一步验证时序性。
items.limitationEn: This study's cross-sectional design prevents establishing causality; longitudinal studies are needed to confirm temporality.

items.title: Divergent functional responses to hyperoxic versus hypoxic high-intensity interval training: a randomized exploratory active-comparator study
items.summary: An exploratory randomized study with 23 active men found divergent functional responses to hyperoxic (FiO₂=0.60, n=13) versus hypoxic (FiO₂=0.16, n=10) Tabata-format HIIT over 3 weeks. Hyperoxia was associated with larger baseline-adjusted improvements in V̇O₂max (from 37.77 to 41.46 mL·kg⁻¹·min⁻¹) and ventilatory thresholds, and lower post-exercise peak lactate, compared to hypoxia.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性随机对照研究表明，在高氧环境下进行 Tabata 格式高强度间歇训练（HIIT）能带来更广泛的有氧功能改善和更低的运动后乳酸峰值，而低氧环境下的改善较小。在你的运动康复或表现训练中，可以考虑氧气分压对训练效果的影响，但需留意该研究的探索性性质和样本量。
items.titleZh: 高氧与低氧高强度间歇训练的不同功能反应：一项随机探索性主动对照研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 23 名活跃男性的探索性随机研究发现，为期 3 周的高氧（FiO₂=0.60，n=13）与低氧（FiO₂=0.16，n=10）Tabata 格式高强度间歇训练产生了不同的功能反应。与低氧组相比，高氧组与 V̇O₂max（从 37.77 升至 41.46 mL·kg⁻¹·min⁻¹）和通气阈值的更大基线调整后改善，以及更低的运动后乳酸峰值相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory randomized controlled study suggests that Tabata-format high-intensity interval training (HIIT) in hyperoxia leads to broader aerobic functional improvements and lower post-exercise peak lactate, while hypoxia yielded smaller gains. In your sports rehabilitation or performance training, consider the influence of inspired oxygen fraction on training outcomes, but be mindful of the study's exploratory nature and sample size.
items.limitation: 本研究为探索性质，样本量小（23 名男性），且缺乏常氧对照组，限制了结论的普遍性和确定性。
items.limitationEn: This exploratory study had a small sample size (23 men) and lacked a normoxic comparator, limiting generalizability and conclusiveness.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Feasibility and safety of immersive virtual reality training device (ReMind) in post-stroke rehabilitation
items.summary: A study with 31 stroke patients found the ReMind immersive VR system feasible and safe for upper-extremity rehabilitation in a single 60-minute session. Participants reported positive experiences (93.6% rated overall experience as "very good" or "good") and no significant changes in vital signs or simulator sickness symptoms, with 87.1% interested in daily use.
items.curatedReason: 这款沉浸式虚拟现实训练设备（ReMind）在卒中后上肢康复中被证实可行且安全，且患者反馈良好。虽然这是一个初步的可行性研究，但它为未来在远程或家庭康复中整合 VR 技术提供了初步依据。
items.titleZh: 沉浸式虚拟现实训练设备（ReMind）在卒中后康复中的可行性与安全性
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 31 名卒中患者的研究发现，ReMind 沉浸式虚拟现实系统在单次 60 分钟的上肢康复训练中是可行且安全的。参与者普遍反馈良好（93.6% 认为整体体验“非常好”或“好”），生命体征和模拟器不适症状无显著变化，87.1% 的人表示有兴趣日常使用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This immersive virtual reality training device (ReMind) was found feasible and safe for post-stroke upper limb rehabilitation, with positive patient feedback. While a preliminary feasibility study, it provides initial grounds for integrating VR technology in future telerehabilitation or home-based rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为单次会话的可行性与安全性评估，未评估长期临床疗效，且样本量较小（31 例）。
items.limitationEn: This study evaluated feasibility and safety for a single session and did not assess long-term clinical efficacy; the sample size was small (31 patients).
items.journal: Bulletin of Faculty of Physical Therapy

items.title: What’s Behind the Label? Rethinking Exercise Prescription for Tendinopathy - BJSM blog - social media's leading SEM voice
items.summary: This BJSM blog post argues that clinicians should document the actual load, effort, range, speed, and external activities in tendinopathy exercise prescriptions, rather than relying solely on labels like "eccentric" or "heavy slow resistance." This approach, termed the Tendon Mechanical Dose Framework, helps explain patient adaptation and guide dose adjustments.
items.curatedReason: 给肌腱病患者开运动处方，别再只写“离心”或“慢速重阻”这类空泛标签了。这篇述评提醒你，必须记录实际的负荷、努力程度、运动范围、速度和患者同时进行的活动。这样才能真正了解治疗效果，并做出精准的剂量调整。
items.titleZh: 标签背后是什么？重新思考肌腱病的运动处方
items.summaryZh: 这篇 BJSM 博客文章指出，临床医生在肌腱病运动处方中应记录实际的负荷、努力程度、运动范围、速度和外部活动，而非仅仅依赖“离心”或“慢速重阻”等标签。这种“肌腱机械剂量框架”的方法有助于解释患者的适应性，并指导剂量调整。
items.curatedReasonEn: This blog emphasizes the importance of "load" over "labels" in tendinopathy exercise prescription. In clinical practice, you should document the actual load, range, speed, and concurrent activities completed by the patient, rather than just terms like "eccentric, isometric, or heavy slow resistance." This helps you more precisely evaluate treatment effects and adjust protocols.

items.title: Outdoor cycling competence and balance control in older adults – cross-sectional analysis of the BiPerAge trial
items.summary: A cross-sectional analysis of 116 community-dwelling adults aged ≥65 years found weak associations between outdoor cycling competence and dynamic balance control. Specifically, longer Four Square Step Test (FSST) time (B = 1.28 [95% CI 0.39, 2.17], p = 0.005) and greater mediolateral trunk sway during unperturbed cycling (B = 2.68 [0.60, 4.77], p = 0.012) were independently associated with more errors on a standardized outdoor cycling course.
items.curatedReason: 评估 65 岁以上老年人的户外骑行能力时，请注意，这项观察研究发现，较长的四方步测验（FSST）时间和非受扰骑行时较大的躯干内外侧摇摆，与更多骑行错误独立相关。把 FSST 时间（每增加 1 秒，错误数平均增加 1.28 个）和骑行中躯干摇摆（每增加 1 度，错误数平均增加 2.68 个）纳入你的评估范围。
items.titleZh: 老年人户外骑行能力与平衡控制——BiPerAge 试验的横断面分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 116 名 65 岁以上社区居住老年人的横断面分析发现，户外骑行能力与动态平衡控制之间存在微弱关联。具体而言，较长的“四方步测验”（FSST）时间 (B = 1.28 [95% CI 0.39, 2.17], p = 0.005) 和非受扰骑行时较大的躯干内外侧摇摆 (B = 2.68 [0.60, 4.77], p = 0.012) 与标准化户外骑行课程中的错误次数独立相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: When assessing outdoor cycling competence in adults aged 65 and older, this observational study suggests you should pay attention to Four Square Step Test (FSST) time and mediolateral trunk sway during unperturbed cycling. Longer FSST time (B = 1.28) and greater trunk sway (B = 2.68) were independently associated with more cycling errors.
items.limitation: 本研究为探索性横断面分析，无法建立因果关系，且关联性相对较弱。
items.limitationEn: This was an exploratory cross-sectional analysis, precluding causal inference, and the associations found were relatively weak.

items.title: The effect of a medication review on the quality of life of community dwelling frail adults with polypharmacy: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review of nine studies found little or no significant effect of medication review interventions on the quality of life (QOL) of community-dwelling frail adults with polypharmacy. The review highlights significant methodological heterogeneity, small sample sizes, and short intervention durations across studies, suggesting a need for more standardized, long-term research.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述表明，药物审查对社区衰弱多重用药老年人的生活质量（QOL）影响甚微或不显著，且研究方法学异质性高。虽然药物管理对老年人至关重要，但在 QOL 结局上，你暂时无需将药物审查视为强有力的直接干预。
items.titleZh: 药物审查对社区衰弱多重用药老年人生活质量的影响：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述纳入了九项研究，发现药物审查干预对社区衰弱多重用药老年人的生活质量（QOL）影响甚微或不显著。该综述强调了研究方法学的高度异质性、小样本量和短干预持续时间，表明需要更标准化和长期性的研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review suggests that medication reviews have little or no significant effect on the quality of life (QOL) of community-dwelling frail older adults with polypharmacy, and studies exhibit high methodological heterogeneity. While medication management is crucial for older adults, you should not currently consider medication review a strong direct intervention for QOL outcomes.
items.limitation: 纳入研究方法学异质性高、样本量小且干预持续时间短，限制了结果的普遍性和临床适用性。
items.limitationEn: Included studies exhibited high methodological heterogeneity, small sample sizes, and short intervention durations, limiting generalizability and clinical applicability.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Two new National Board Chairs appointed
items.summary: The Ministerial Council for the National Registration and Accreditation Scheme has appointed new Chairs for the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia (Dr. Paula Medway) and the Chiropractic Board of Australia (Dr. Michael Shobbrook AM). Additionally, eight members were appointed or re-appointed to various National Boards.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚国家注册和认证计划宣布任命护理与助产委员会以及脊骨神经医学委员会的新主席。这些任命是澳大利亚卫生专业监管体系的常规动态，对你的日常执业没有直接影响，但反映了专业领导层的变化。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构：任命两位新的国家委员会主席
items.summaryZh: 国家注册和认证计划的部长级理事会任命了澳大利亚护理与助产委员会的新主席 Paula Medway 博士和脊骨神经医学委员会的新主席 Michael Shobbrook AM 博士。此外，还有八名成员被任命或再次任命到不同的国家委员会。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian National Registration and Accreditation Scheme has announced new Chairs for the Nursing and Midwifery and Chiropractic Boards. These are routine changes in Australia's health professional regulatory system, without direct impact on your daily practice, but reflect shifts in professional leadership.

items.title: Delivering a high-dose walking booster program after stroke: a multimethod study of therapists' beliefs and experiences nested within a randomized trial.
items.summary: A multimethod study explored therapists' beliefs and experiences delivering a high-dose walking booster program (HiWalk) within a Phase II trial (n=6 therapists). Therapists believed high-dose training was important (98.5/100) but were less confident about patients completing 3 hours/day (74.8/100). Training, team support, and resources facilitated delivery, while beliefs about patient capability and resource limitations were barriers.
items.curatedReason: 高剂量步态训练是方向，但别指望患者能轻松完成每天3小时的训练，治疗师自己对此信心也一般（74.8/100）。实施时，务必提供充足培训、资源和团队支持，这比治疗师对患者能力的预判更关键。
items.titleZh: 卒中后高剂量步态强化训练计划的实施：一项多方法研究，探讨治疗师在随机试验中的信念和经验
items.summaryZh: 一项多方法研究探讨了在II期试验中，治疗师实施高剂量步态强化计划 (HiWalk) 的信念和经验 (n=6名治疗师)。治疗师认为高剂量训练很重要 (98.5/100)，但对患者每天完成3小时训练的信心较低 (74.8/100)。培训、团队支持和资源是促进因素，而对患者能力的信念和资源限制是障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-dose gait training is crucial, but don't assume patients will easily complete 3 hours/day; therapists themselves are only moderately confident (74.8/100). When implementing, prioritize ample training, resources, and team support; these factors are more critical than a therapist's pre-assessment of patient capability.
items.limitation: 本研究基于一个小型II期临床试验，样本量有限（6名治疗师），可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This study was nested within a small Phase II trial with a limited sample size of 6 therapists, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Early postoperative functional exercise adherence and its association with 3-month hip functional recovery among older adults after femoral neck fracture surgery: a prospective observational study.
items.summary: A prospective observational study (n=230 older adults) found that early postoperative functional exercise adherence (mean score 49.9±6.9) before discharge was positively correlated with 3-month Harris Hip Score (r=0.838, p<0.001) after femoral neck fracture surgery. Adherence was negatively correlated with kinesiophobia (r=-0.753) and pain (r=-0.399), and positively correlated with rehabilitation self-efficacy (r=0.754) and social support (r=0.893).
items.curatedReason: 出院前早期功能锻炼依从性对老年髋部骨折术后3个月功能恢复有显著关联。你应当在临床中优先关注患者的运动恐惧症、康复自我效能、社会支持和疼痛管理，以提高依从性并改善预后。
items.titleZh: 股骨颈骨折术后老年人早期功能锻炼依从性及其与3个月髋关节功能恢复的关联：一项前瞻性观察研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察研究 (n=230名老年人) 发现，股骨颈骨折术后出院前早期功能锻炼依从性 (平均得分49.9±6.9) 与3个月Harris髋关节评分呈正相关 (r=0.838, p<0.001)。依从性与运动恐惧症 (r=-0.753) 和疼痛 (r=-0.399) 呈负相关，与康复自我效能 (r=0.754) 和社会支持 (r=0.893) 呈正相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Early postoperative functional exercise adherence before discharge is significantly associated with 3-month hip functional recovery after femoral neck fracture surgery in older adults. You should prioritize addressing kinesiophobia, rehabilitation self-efficacy, social support, and pain management in clinical practice to enhance adherence and improve outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为前瞻性观察研究，尽管发现了依从性与恢复之间的关联，但不能建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was a prospective observational study, and while it found associations between adherence and recovery, it cannot establish causality.

items.title: Physiotherapy management of persistent pelvic pain.
items.summary: This review article outlines physiotherapy management strategies for persistent pelvic pain, covering various evidence-based interventions.
items.curatedReason: 处理慢性盆腔痛，你大概率需要一个多模式的方法。这篇综述清晰梳理了目前常用的证据支持疗法，你可以此作为临床实践的起点。
items.titleZh: 持续性盆腔疼痛的物理治疗管理
items.summaryZh: 本综述文章概述了持续性盆腔疼痛的物理治疗管理策略，涵盖了多种循证干预措施。
items.curatedReasonEn: Persistent pelvic pain usually requires a multimodal approach. This review clearly outlines current evidence-based interventions, offering a solid starting point for your clinical practice.

items.title: Effects of extracorporeal shockwave therapy on pain intensity and functional disability in chronic low back pain: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 9 RCTs found that extracorporeal shockwave therapy (ESWT), particularly radial ESWT (rESWT), significantly reduced pain in chronic low back pain (SMD = -0.72; 95% CI -1.30 to -0.14), but functional disability improvements (MD = -6.12) did not reach the minimal clinically important difference.
items.curatedReason: 本系统综述提示，尽管体外冲击波疗法（ESWT）能短期缓解慢性下腰痛的疼痛，但对功能障碍的改善未达临床最小重要差异（MCID）。在功能改善不明显的情况下，不应将ESWT作为常规干预。对于非响应性患者，可考虑作为辅助治疗，但其作用有限。
items.titleZh: 体外冲击波疗法对慢性下腰痛疼痛强度和功能障碍的影响：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 9 项随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析显示，体外冲击波疗法（ESWT），特别是径向 ESWT (rESWT)，可显著减轻慢性下腰痛的疼痛（SMD = -0.72；95% CI -1.30 至 -0.14），但功能障碍的改善（MD = -6.12）未达到最小临床重要差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review suggests that while ESWT may reduce pain in chronic low back pain in the short term, functional improvements do not meet the minimal clinically important difference (MCID). Given the limited functional benefit, ESWT should not be considered a routine intervention. It may serve as an adjunct for non-responsive patients, but its role remains limited.
items.limitation: 该综述纳入的研究大多只评估了即刻干预后的结果，随访时间短，且研究间存在显著异质性（I² = 76%），可能影响证据强度。
items.limitationEn: Most included studies assessed only immediate post-intervention outcomes, with short follow-up and substantial heterogeneity (I² = 76%) across studies, potentially limiting the strength of evidence.

items.title: Physical activity guidelines' impact on cognition in multiple sclerosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 12 RCTs (n=462) found that meeting physical activity guidelines for multiple sclerosis (PAG-MS) significantly improved processing speed (SMD = 0.29), visuospatial memory (SMD = 0.47), and verbal memory (SMD = 0.75) in individuals with MS.
items.curatedReason: 对于 MS 患者，达到身体活动指南（PAG-MS）的推荐量，是改善他们处理速度、视觉空间记忆和言语记忆的明确有效途径。你的临床实践中，应将推动患者达到这些指南放在优先位置，将其作为认知干预的核心组成部分。
items.titleZh: 身体活动指南对多发性硬化症患者认知功能的影响：随机临床试验的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 12 项随机对照试验（n=462）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，达到多发性硬化症（MS）患者的身体活动指南（PAG-MS）可显著改善 MS 患者的加工速度（SMD = 0.29）、视觉空间记忆（SMD = 0.47）和言语记忆（SMD = 0.75）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For your MS patients, meeting the Physical Activity Guidelines (PAG-MS) is a clearly effective strategy to improve their processing speed, visuospatial memory, and verbal memory. Prioritize promoting adherence to these guidelines in your clinical practice; it's a core component of cognitive intervention.
items.limitation: 该研究结果基于有限数量的试验且存在较高的偏倚风险，因此需要更多高质量的随机对照试验来进一步确证。
items.limitationEn: The findings are based on a limited number of trials with a high risk of bias, necessitating more high-quality RCTs for further confirmation.

items.title: Significant others' perspectives on formal supports at 3- and 12-months post-discharge from specialist rehabilitation units following acquired brain injury and spinal cord injury.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored significant others' perspectives on formal supports in the first year post-discharge following acquired brain injury and spinal cord injury. Four themes emerged, highlighting challenges in navigating complex pathways, the importance of communication, prioritizing individualized support, and significant others becoming a safety net due to gaps in formal support.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了脑损伤和脊髓损伤患者家属在出院后第一年对正式支持服务的看法，特别是在沟通和弥补服务空白方面的困难。在制定康复计划和出院指导时，你应更主动地将重要家属纳入决策过程，并提供清晰、主动的指导以帮助他们导航支持系统。
items.titleZh: 脑损伤和脊髓损伤患者出院后 3 个月和 12 个月时重要他人的正式支持体验：定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了脑损伤和脊髓损伤患者出院后第一年重要他人在正式支持方面的经验和障碍。研究揭示了四项主题，强调了重要他人面对复杂路径、沟通重要性、个性化支持优先以及由于正式支持不足而成为安全网的体验。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights the challenges faced by family members of individuals with acquired brain injury (ABI) and spinal cord injury (SCI) in accessing formal supports during the first year post-discharge, especially regarding communication and bridging service gaps. When developing rehabilitation plans and discharge guidance, you should proactively involve significant others in decision-making and provide clear, proactive guidance to help them navigate support systems.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量相对较小（3个月随访 n=24，12个月随访 n=19），其发现的普遍性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a relatively small sample size (n=24 at 3 months, n=19 at 12 months), which may limit the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Process evaluation of daily electrical stimulation to prevent recurring pressure ulcers in individuals with spinal cord injury: the SCI PREVOLT trial.
items.summary: A mixed-methods process evaluation (RE-AIM framework) of a daily electrical stimulation (ES) intervention for pressure ulcer prevention in individuals with spinal cord injury (n=70 participants, 13 healthcare professionals) identified facilitators (recruitment via rehabilitation, PU prevention motivation) and barriers (limited evidence, usability, reimbursement issues, time constraints, need for assistance) to implementation in home and rehabilitation settings.
items.curatedReason: 这项过程评估显示，尽管电刺激（ES）在预防脊髓损伤（SCI）患者压疮方面有潜力，但在家庭和康复环境中实施仍面临多重障碍，包括证据有限、可用性问题和报销机制缺失。在推广ES作为预防手段时，你应关注改善其用户友好性，并争取明确的角色分工和强有力的支持，以克服这些实施挑战。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤患者日常电刺激预防复发性压疮的过程评估：SCI PREVOLT 试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对脊髓损伤患者（n=70，13 名医护人员）日常电刺激（ES）预防压疮干预的混合方法过程评估（RE-AIM 框架）确定了在家庭和康复环境中实施的促进因素（通过康复机构招募、压疮预防动机）和障碍（有限证据、可用性、报销问题、时间限制、需要协助）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This process evaluation reveals that despite the potential of electrical stimulation (ES) for pressure ulcer (PU) prevention in individuals with spinal cord injury (SCI), implementation in home and rehabilitation settings faces multiple barriers, including limited evidence, usability issues, and lack of reimbursement. When promoting ES for PU prevention, you should focus on improving its user-friendliness and advocate for clear role definitions and strong support to overcome these implementation challenges.
items.limitation: 本研究为过程评估，主要侧重于干预的实施情况，而非其临床疗效。
items.limitationEn: This study is a process evaluation, primarily focusing on intervention implementation rather than its clinical efficacy.

items.title: Effects of Single-Session High-Definition Transcranial Alternating Current Stimulation (HD-tACS) Combined with Robot-Assisted Hand Exercises on Corticospinal Excitability in Chronic Stroke.
items.summary: A preliminary randomized crossover study (12 healthy adults, 7 chronic stroke patients) investigated single-session high-definition transcranial alternating current stimulation (HD-tACS) combined with robot-assisted hand exercises. HD-tACS significantly increased flexor digitorum superficialis (FDS) MEP amplitudes by 15.3% in healthy individuals and by ~22.3% in stroke patients (not statistically significant, but significant when normalized as percentage change), suggesting enhanced corticospinal excitability.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究提示，单次高清晰度经颅交流电刺激（HD-tACS）结合机器人辅助手部练习，可能增强健康个体和慢性卒中患者的皮质脊髓兴奋性。虽然结果令人鼓舞，但目前证据仅为单次会话小样本研究，不应作为常规临床实践改变，需要等待更大规模的研究确认其长期疗效。
items.titleZh: 单次高清晰度经颅交流电刺激（HD-tACS）结合机器人辅助手部练习对慢性卒中皮质脊髓兴奋性的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项初步的随机交叉研究（12 名健康成人，7 名慢性卒中患者）调查了单次高清晰度经颅交流电刺激（HD-tACS）结合机器人辅助手部练习的效果。HD-tACS 使健康个体指浅屈肌（FDS）MEP 振幅显著增加 15.3%，慢性卒中患者增加约 22.3%（未达统计学显著，但归一化百分比变化后显著），提示皮质脊髓兴奋性增强。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study suggests that a single session of high-definition transcranial alternating current stimulation (HD-tACS) combined with robot-assisted hand exercises may enhance corticospinal excitability in both healthy individuals and chronic stroke patients. While encouraging, this evidence is from a small, single-session study and should not yet alter routine clinical practice. Confirmation from larger, long-term studies is needed.
items.limitation: 本研究为初步的小样本研究（12 名健康成人，7 名慢性卒中患者），且只评估了单次干预的效果，无法得出长期疗效或常规应用的结论。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary study with a small sample size (12 healthy adults, 7 chronic stroke patients) and assessed only the effect of a single intervention, precluding conclusions on long-term efficacy or routine application.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: How do neurorehabilitation patients perceive their fundamental care needs? Findings from a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored neurorehabilitation patients' (stroke, MS, Parkinson's, neurosurgical oncology) perceptions of fundamental care needs within the Fundamentals of Care (FoC) framework. Patients valued physical care (hygiene, mobility) for dignity, psychosocial care (communication, emotional support) for agency, and relational care (empathy, continuity) for safety, highlighting care as interconnected and beyond task-based models.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究强调了神经康复患者对基本护理需求的感知超越了单纯的身体任务，更侧重于尊严、情感支持和关系性存在。在制定护理计划时，你应将基本护理视为一个多维度且互相关联的过程，并提升健康助理在提供以舒适和关系为中心的护理中的作用。
items.titleZh: 神经康复患者如何看待其基本护理需求？一项定性研究的结果
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了神经康复患者（卒中、多发性硬化症、帕金森病、神经外科肿瘤）在基本护理（FoC）框架内对其基本护理需求的感知。患者重视身体护理（卫生、活动性）以维护尊严，重视心理社会护理（沟通、情感支持）以获得自主权，重视关系性护理（同理心、连续性）以保障安全，强调护理是多维度且超越任务型模式的。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights that neurorehabilitation patients' perceptions of fundamental care needs extend beyond mere physical tasks, emphasizing dignity, emotional support, and relational presence. When developing care plans, you should view fundamental care as a multidimensional and interconnected process, and elevate the role of healthcare assistants in providing comfort-focused and relational care.
items.limitation: 该研究为定性研究，通过二次分析来自意大利一家康复医院的数据，其发现可能具有地域性和文化特异性。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study is based on secondary analysis of data from a rehabilitation hospital in Italy, so its findings may be geographically and culturally specific.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Acceptability, Safety and Feasibility of a Sedentary Behaviour Intervention (REACH-SCI) in Individuals with Spinal Cord Injury: A Mixed-Methods Study
items.summary: A mixed-methods pre-post feasibility study (n=18 wheelchair-users with paraplegia) evaluated an 8-week sedentary behavior intervention (REACH-SCI) combining a wearable tracker, education, goal setting, motivational support, peer support, and activity tools. The intervention was found acceptable, safe, and feasible, with high engagement (except peer support) and preliminary efficacy in improving sedentary behavior, physical activity, cardiovascular disease biomarkers, and psychosocial outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项混合方法研究显示，旨在减少脊髓损伤患者久坐行为的REACH-SCI干预措施是可接受、安全且可行的，并且初步显示出改善久坐行为、身体活动和心血管生物标志物的效果。在等待确定性试验结果的同时，你可以考虑将这类多组件干预措施作为促进脊髓损伤患者身体活动的潜在策略。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤患者久坐行为干预（REACH-SCI）的可接受性、安全性及可行性：一项混合方法研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 18 名截瘫轮椅使用者的混合方法前瞻性可行性研究评估了为期 8 周的久坐行为干预（REACH-SCI），该干预结合了可穿戴追踪器、教育、目标设定、动机支持、同伴支持和活动工具。研究发现该干预措施可接受、安全且可行，参与度高（同伴支持除外），并初步显示在改善久坐行为、身体活动、心血管疾病生物标志物和心理社会结局方面的疗效。
items.curatedReasonEn: This mixed-methods study indicates that the REACH-SCI intervention, designed to reduce sedentary behavior in individuals with spinal cord injury, is acceptable, safe, and feasible, with preliminary efficacy in improving sedentary behavior, physical activity, and cardiovascular biomarkers. While awaiting definitive trial results, you might consider such multi-component interventions as a potential strategy to promote physical activity in SCI patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为前瞻性可行性研究，样本量较小（n=18），且缺乏对照组，因此其初步疗效结果应谨慎解读，不宜直接推广为临床实践。
items.limitationEn: This pre-post feasibility study has a small sample size (n=18) and lacks a control group, so its preliminary efficacy results should be interpreted cautiously and not directly generalized to clinical practice.

items.title: Barriers and Facilitators Influencing Physiotherapists' Adherence to Clinical Practice Guidelines and Return to Sport Criteria after Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: A Qualitative Study in Austria.
items.summary: A qualitative study in Austria explored barriers and facilitators for physiotherapists' adherence to ACLR CPGs and RTS criteria. Nine physiotherapists participated, revealing limited guideline usability, patient expectations, professional attitudes, and interprofessional misalignment as key barriers, while structured guidelines and professional development facilitated adherence.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了阻碍物理治疗师依从 ACLR 临床实践指南和重返运动标准的因素。它指出了指南可用性、患者期望、专业态度和跨专业沟通是关键障碍。
items.titleZh: 影响物理治疗师依从前交叉韧带重建临床实践指南和重返运动标准的障碍与促进因素：一项奥地利定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项奥地利定性研究调查了影响物理治疗师依从 ACLR 临床实践指南和重返运动标准的障碍与促进因素。研究发现，指南可用性有限、患者期望、专业态度和跨专业协作失调是主要障碍，而结构化指南和专业发展则能促进依从性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study identifies factors hindering physiotherapists' adherence to ACLR clinical practice guidelines and return-to-sport criteria. It highlights guideline usability, patient expectations, professional attitudes, and interprofessional communication as key barriers.
items.limitation: 本定性研究的样本量较小（9 名物理治疗师），可能影响结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The small sample size of this qualitative study (9 physiotherapists) may limit the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Feasibility of Distributed Wearable Ultrasound for Detecting Neuromuscular Coordination Differences After Knee Injury
items.summary: A feasibility study with 20 NCAA Division I women athletes (8 with prior knee injury) using a four-channel distributed wearable ultrasound (D-WUS) system revealed significant differences in right-limb VL-VMO correlation (p = 0.029) and timing symmetry (p = 0.019) in injured participants during countermovement jumps, despite similar jump performance metrics.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究提示，分布式可穿戴超声能识别膝关节损伤后，即使在跳跃表现正常的情况下，也能检测到神经肌肉协调性的差异。这为你评估患者深层功能障碍提供了新的思路。
items.titleZh: 分布式可穿戴超声在检测膝关节损伤后神经肌肉协调性差异的可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 20 名 NCAA 一级女运动员（其中 8 名有膝关节损伤史）进行的跳跃可行性研究，使用四通道分布式可穿戴超声系统，在反向运动跳跃中发现损伤组右侧肢体的股外侧肌-股内侧斜肌相关性（p = 0.029）和时序对称性（p = 0.019）存在显著差异，尽管跳跃表现指标相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study suggests that distributed wearable ultrasound can detect neuromuscular coordination differences after knee injury, even when jumping performance appears normal. This offers new insights for assessing deeper functional impairments in your patients.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（20 名运动员，其中 8 名有膝关节损伤史），且为初步的可行性研究，结果尚需大规模前瞻性研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This preliminary feasibility study has a small sample size (20 athletes, 8 with prior knee injury), and its findings require validation in larger prospective studies.

items.title: Development and validation of a prediction model for subsequent fractures after hip fracture surgery in older adults: a retrospective cohort study.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study developed and validated a nomogram to predict subsequent fractures within 2 years after hip fracture surgery in older adults. The model, incorporating factors like age, hip function, neurodegenerative disease, eye disease, living alone, and exercise, demonstrated good discriminative performance (C-index 0.891 in development, 0.861 in validation).
items.curatedReason: 老年髋部骨折术后发生二次骨折的风险很高。这个预测模型能帮你识别出高危患者，以便早期干预、减少二次骨折的发生。
items.titleZh: 老年髋部骨折术后二次骨折预测模型的开发与验证：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究开发并验证了一个用于预测老年髋部骨折术后 2 年内二次骨折的列线图。该模型纳入了年龄、髋关节功能、神经退行性疾病、眼疾、独居和运动等因素，在开发队列（C-index 0.891）和验证队列（0.861）中均表现出良好的判别性能。
items.curatedReasonEn: The risk of subsequent fractures after hip fracture surgery in older adults is significant. This prediction model helps identify high-risk patients, enabling early intervention to reduce secondary fractures.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，且仅在两个队列中进行了时间验证，可能存在选择偏倚和数据局限性。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective cohort study and temporal validation in only two cohorts may be subject to selection bias and data limitations.

items.title: Effects of treadmill exercise with and without vertical traction on gait, pain, disability, trunk proprioception, and depression in patients with chronic mechanical low back pain: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial with 45 chronic low back pain patients found that treadmill exercise with vertical traction and partial body weight support (VT+TE) led to greater improvements in Timed Up and Go performance, self-selected gait speed, disability, and trunk repositioning errors compared to treadmill exercise alone or core stabilization exercises.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示，在慢性腰痛患者的跑步机训练中加入垂直牵引与部分体重支持，能进一步改善步态、功能障碍和躯干本体感觉。在考虑进阶方案时，可以纳入此辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 跑步机训练结合或不结合垂直牵引对慢性机械性腰痛患者步态、疼痛、功能障碍、躯干本体感觉和抑郁的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 45 名慢性机械性腰痛患者的随机对照试验发现，跑步机训练结合垂直牵引和部分体重支持（VT+TE）在计时起跑、自选步速、功能障碍和躯干复位误差方面，比单纯跑步机训练或核心稳定训练带来更大改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that adding vertical traction and partial body weight support to treadmill exercise for chronic low back pain patients can further improve gait, disability, and trunk proprioception. Consider incorporating this adjunct for advanced intervention strategies.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且未能区分垂直卸载与吊带支持的独立效应。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size and could not distinguish the independent effects of vertical unloading from harness support.

items.title: Long-Term Clinical Outcomes and Factors Associated With Response in Older Adults With Massive Irreparable Rotator Cuff Tears: A Four-Year Prospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A 4-year prospective cohort study of 92 older adults with atraumatic massive irreparable rotator cuff tears found that 95-97% of patients achieved minimal clinically important difference at 3 months, with 100% achieving it by 4 years with nonoperative treatment. Longer symptom duration and smoking were associated with worse shoulder function, while diabetes was linked to higher pain intensity.
items.curatedReason: 这项长期队列研究证实，大多数老年不可修复性肩袖撕裂患者通过非手术治疗可获得并维持良好的功能改善，长达 4 年。在与患者讨论治疗路径时，你可以更有信心地推荐非手术方案，并关注症状持续时间、吸烟和糖尿病等修饰因素。
items.titleZh: 老年不可修复性巨大肩袖撕裂患者非手术治疗的长期临床结局及相关因素：一项四年前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 92 名老年无创伤性不可修复性巨大肩袖撕裂患者进行的 4 年前瞻性队列研究发现，95-97% 的患者在 3 个月时通过非手术治疗达到最小临床重要差异，并在 4 年时达到 100%。症状持续时间较长和吸烟与较差的肩关节功能相关，而糖尿病与较高的疼痛强度相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This long-term cohort study confirms that most older patients with massive irreparable rotator cuff tears achieve and maintain good functional improvement with nonoperative treatment for up to 4 years. When discussing treatment pathways, you can more confidently recommend nonoperative approaches, while considering modifiable factors like symptom duration, smoking, and diabetes.
items.limitation: 单中心队列研究，且部分患者最终接受了手术治疗。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center cohort study, and some patients ultimately underwent surgery.

items.title: Efficacy of Sensory Electrical Stimulation Versus Alternating Electromyography-Guided Electrical Stimulation on Functional Recovery of the Hand in Chronic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A three-arm randomized controlled trial of 60 chronic stroke patients found that both Sensory Electrical Stimulation (SES) and alternating electromyography-guided electrical stimulation (Alt-EMG), combined with conventional physical therapy, produced greater improvements in Action Research Arm Test scores (adjusted mean gains of 12.05 and 12.44 points, respectively, both P < .001) compared to conventional physical therapy alone, with no significant difference between SES and Alt-EMG.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 证实，在慢性卒中患者的手功能康复中，感觉电刺激 (SES) 和交替肌电引导电刺激 (Alt-EMG) 均能显著优于单独常规物理治疗，但两者之间无明显差异。这支持了在临床中灵活选用这两种电刺激模式，而非偏执于某一种。
items.titleZh: 感觉电刺激与交替肌电引导电刺激对慢性卒中患者手功能恢复的疗效比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 60 名慢性卒中患者的三臂随机对照试验发现，感觉电刺激 (SES) 和交替肌电引导电刺激 (Alt-EMG) 结合常规物理治疗，在动作研究臂测试（ARAT）评分上均比单独常规物理治疗有显著改善（调整后平均增益分别为 12.05 和 12.44 分，两者 P < .001），且 SES 和 Alt-EMG 之间无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT confirms that both Sensory Electrical Stimulation (SES) and Alternating Electromyography-Guided Electrical Stimulation (Alt-EMG) significantly improve hand function in chronic stroke patients compared to conventional physical therapy alone, with no significant difference between the two electrical stimulation methods. This supports flexible use of either modality in clinical practice, rather than adhering to one exclusively.
items.limitation: 研究人群年龄限制在 45-65 岁，可能影响结果向其他年龄段的推广。
items.limitationEn: The study population was limited to ages 45-65 years, potentially affecting generalizability to other age groups.

items.title: Do treatment parameters of dry needling influence its effect on pain? A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 71 comparisons, with 23 in quantitative synthesis, found no consistent evidence that dry needling treatment parameters (number of sessions, muscles treated, or local twitch responses) moderate its effectiveness for neck pain, citing high heterogeneity and incomplete reporting.
items.curatedReason: 干针治疗颈痛的疗效，似乎不依赖于治疗参数。这意味着你无需纠结于疗程次数或特定肌肉，只需关注患者反应进行调整即可，但要警惕其研究局限性。
items.titleZh: 干针治疗参数是否影响其对疼痛的疗效？一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 71 项比较（23 项进行定量综合）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，目前没有一致证据表明干针治疗参数（疗程次数、治疗肌肉数量或引发的局部抽搐反应）能调节其对颈痛的疗效，并指出研究存在高度异质性和报告不完整问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: The effectiveness of dry needling for neck pain appears independent of specific treatment parameters. This suggests you can focus on patient response rather than rigidly adhering to session counts or muscle targets, while acknowledging the study's limitations.
items.limitation: 研究存在显著异质性、报告不完整和偏倚风险，限制了结果的可靠性，且仅限于颈痛研究。
items.limitationEn: Significant heterogeneity, incomplete reporting, and high risk of bias limit the reliability of findings, which were also restricted to neck pain studies.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Trends in Australia's physiotherapy workforce: changes and future implications.
items.summary: Analysis of Australia's National Health Workforce Dataset (2013-2023) showed a 70.5% increase in physiotherapists (from 21,046 to 35,889), but 81.0% still practiced in metropolitan areas. Males were 15% less likely than females to practice in regional centers, while Indigenous physiotherapists were 85% more likely to practice outside metropolitan areas.
items.curatedReason: 这项澳大利亚物理治疗师劳动力趋势研究显示，尽管总人数增加，但城乡分布不均问题依旧突出。如果你考虑在澳大利亚执业，特别是男性或非原住民背景，在选择偏远地区工作时需注意可能存在的激励与支持不足。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚物理治疗师劳动力趋势：变化与未来影响
items.summaryZh: 对澳大利亚国家卫生劳动力数据集（2013-2023 年）的分析显示，物理治疗师数量增加了 70.5%（从 21,046 人增至 35,889 人），但仍有 81.0% 在大都市地区执业。男性在区域中心执业的可能性比女性低 15%，而原住民物理治疗师在都市区以外执业的可能性高 85%。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study on Australia's physiotherapy workforce trends indicates that despite an increase in overall numbers, maldistribution between urban and rural areas remains prominent. If you are considering practicing in Australia, especially as a male or non-Indigenous individual, be aware of potential lack of incentives and support when choosing remote locations.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察研究，依赖于现有数据集，无法推断因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective observational study relying on existing datasets, precluding causal inferences.

items.title: Effect of bimodal signal biofeedback on the supraglottic swallowing maneuver in patients with post-stroke dysphagia: A randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial of 30 post-stroke dysphagia patients found that adding bimodal biofeedback (accelerometer and nasal airflow sensor) to supraglottic swallowing maneuver training significantly improved Functional Oral Intake Scale (FOIS) scores (p < 0.001) and reduced the percentage of Penetration-Aspiration Scale (PAS) scores ≥ 6 (p = 0.026) after 2 weeks and at 1-month follow-up, compared to conventional therapy alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 发现，在卒中后吞咽困难患者的声门上吞咽动作训练中，结合双模式生物反馈（加速度计和鼻气流传感器）能显著提升吞咽功能。在优化吞咽康复方案时，应考虑纳入此类生物反馈技术以提高疗效。
items.titleZh: 双模式信号生物反馈对卒中后吞咽困难患者声门上吞咽动作的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 30 名卒中后吞咽困难患者的随机对照试验发现，在声门上吞咽动作训练中加入双模式信号生物反馈（加速度计和鼻气流传感器）后，与单独常规治疗相比，患者的功能性经口进食量表（FOIS）评分显著提高（p < 0.001），且穿透-吸入量表（PAS）评分≥ 6 的百分比在治疗后和 1 个月随访时均显著降低（p = 0.026）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that incorporating bimodal biofeedback (accelerometer and nasal airflow sensor) significantly improves swallowing function in post-stroke dysphagia patients undergoing supraglottic swallowing maneuver training. When optimizing swallowing rehabilitation protocols, consider integrating such biofeedback technologies to enhance efficacy.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，为单中心研究，且干预时间较短（2周）。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size, is single-center, and has a short intervention duration (2 weeks).
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation
