items.title: Implementation, feasibility and optimization of a web- and mobile-supported semi-automated shoulder rehabilitation system (WMSSR): a prospective consecutive interventional cohort study.
items.summary: A prospective cohort study of 129 patients with non-traumatic shoulder pain or dysfunction found that a web- and mobile-supported semi-automated shoulder rehabilitation system (WMSSR) was feasible to implement and associated with an 89% reduction in total clinical deficit score (mean change 13.8 ± 5.5, 95% CI 12.83-14.75; effect size d₍z₎ = 2.513; p < 0.001) over approximately 2.8 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项队列研究展示了数字支持型肩关节康复系统在常规临床实践中的可行性与初步疗效。尽管缺乏对照组，但其显著的患者依从性与功能改善数据，提示该系统有望优化肩部康复流程。
items.titleZh: 网络和移动支持型半自动化肩部康复系统 (WMSSR) 的实施、可行性及优化：一项前瞻性队列干预研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 129 名非创伤性肩痛或功能障碍患者进行的前瞻性队列研究发现，网络和移动支持型半自动化肩部康复系统 (WMSSR) 可行性良好，并与平均约 2.8 个月内总临床缺陷评分降低 89%（平均变化 13.8 ± 5.5；95% CI 12.83-14.75；效应量 d₍z₎ = 2.513；p < 0.001）相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cohort study demonstrates the feasibility and initial effectiveness of a digitally supported shoulder rehabilitation system in routine clinical practice. Despite lacking a control group, its significant patient adherence and functional improvement data suggest potential for optimizing shoulder rehabilitation workflows.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心队列干预研究，无随机化和对照组，外部有效性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center interventional cohort study without randomization or a control group, limiting its external validity.

items.title: A Machine Learning Model With Temporal Validation for Predicting Walking Ability in Nontraumatic Spinal Cord Injury.
items.summary: A retrospective study developed a Gradient Boosting Decision Tree (GBDT) model using early admission clinical indicators to predict walking ability in 148 nontraumatic spinal cord injury patients, achieving an AUC of 0.91 (95% CI: 0.77-1.00) and accuracy of 0.90 (95% CI: 0.77-1.00) on internal testing, with encouraging external validation performance.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究开发了一个机器学习模型，可以利用早期临床指标预测非创伤性脊髓损伤患者的步行能力。尽管仍需大规模多中心验证，但该模型提示未来有望实现更精准的康复规划和资源分配。
items.titleZh: 一项基于时间验证的机器学习模型，用于预测非创伤性脊髓损伤患者的步行能力
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性研究开发了基于梯度提升决策树 (GBDT) 的模型，利用早期入院临床指标预测 148 名非创伤性脊髓损伤患者的步行能力，内部测试的 AUC 为 0.91（95% CI: 0.77-1.00），准确率为 0.90（95% CI: 0.77-1.00），外部验证表现也令人鼓舞。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study developed a machine learning model that can predict walking ability in nontraumatic spinal cord injury patients using early clinical indicators. While large-scale multicenter validation is still needed, the model suggests potential for more precise rehabilitation planning and resource allocation in the future.
items.limitation: 模型在单一中心且样本量较小的患者群体中开发和验证，需要更大规模的多中心研究进一步确认。
items.limitationEn: The model was developed and validated in a single-center, relatively small patient cohort, requiring confirmation in larger, multicenter studies.

items.title: Quality of Movement Assessment after ACL Reconstruction in Youth: A Clinical Framework to Guide Rehabilitation and Return-to-Sport Decision-Making.
items.summary: A clinical commentary proposes a framework for integrating qualitative movement assessment tools, including single-leg, double-leg, and change-of-direction tasks, into rehabilitation and return-to-sport decision-making for pediatric and adolescent patients following ACL reconstruction.
items.curatedReason: 这份临床评述提供了一个框架，指导青少年 ACL 重建术后患者的运动质量评估，以辅助康复和重返运动决策。在实践中，您应将定性运动评估工具纳入常规流程，超越单纯的定量指标。
items.titleZh: 青少年 ACL 重建术后运动质量评估：指导康复和重返运动决策的临床框架
items.summaryZh: 一份临床评述提出一个框架，旨在将定性运动评估工具，包括单腿、双腿和变向任务，整合到青少年 ACL 重建术后患者的康复和重返运动决策中。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical commentary provides a framework for assessing movement quality in youth patients after ACL reconstruction, guiding rehabilitation and return-to-sport decisions. In practice, you should integrate qualitative movement assessment tools into your routine, moving beyond purely quantitative metrics.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Force Plate Based Assessment of Maximal and Rapid Isometric Shoulder Strength During the Return-to-Sport Process After Pectoralis Major Repair in a World-Class Female Wrestler: A Case Report.
items.summary: A case report of a world-class female wrestler post-pectoralis major repair demonstrated that force plate-based assessment, specifically Net Force at 200 ms (NF200), revealed lagging recovery of rapid force production compared to Net Peak Force (NPF), suggesting multi-directional and continued neuromuscular monitoring during return-to-sport.
items.curatedReason: 这份病例报告展示了在世界级女性摔跤手胸大肌修复术后，使用测力台评估最大和快速等长肩关节力量在重返运动过程中的应用。该方法提示，在康复后期需要关注快速力量的恢复，因为其可能滞后于峰值力量。
items.titleZh: 世界级女子摔跤运动员胸大肌修复术后重返运动过程中基于测力台的最大和快速等长肩关节力量评估：一例病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一项关于一名世界级女子摔跤运动员胸大肌修复术后的病例报告显示，基于测力台的评估，特别是 200 毫秒净力（NF200），揭示了快速力量产出恢复滞后于净峰值力（NPF），提示在重返运动过程中需要进行多方向和持续的神经肌肉监测。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report demonstrates the use of force plate assessment for maximal and rapid isometric shoulder strength during the return-to-sport process after pectoralis major repair in a world-class female wrestler. This method suggests that attention to rapid force recovery is needed in later rehabilitation stages, as it may lag behind peak force.
items.limitation: 为单例病例报告，结果无法推广到一般人群。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, and findings are not generalizable to the broader population.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Sensorimotor and Molecular Mechanisms of Non-Contact ACL Injury: An Integrative Hypothesis.
items.summary: A clinical commentary proposes an integrative hypothesis for non-contact ACL injury, emphasizing the decisive protective role of feed-forward hamstring tension, calcium-dependent stiffening of titin, and short-range muscle stiffness, highlighting pre-contact landing strategies and eccentric strength training as cornerstones of injury prevention.
items.curatedReason: 这份临床评述提出了非接触性 ACL 损伤的整合性假说，强调了预接触期腘绳肌张力、肌联蛋白钙依赖性硬化和短程肌肉僵硬的关键保护作用。这强化了你在预防 ACL 损伤时，应将注意力放在着地策略和离心力量训练上。
items.titleZh: 非接触性 ACL 损伤的感觉运动和分子机制：一项整合性假说
items.summaryZh: 一份临床评述提出了非接触性 ACL 损伤的整合性假说，强调了前馈腘绳肌张力、肌联蛋白钙依赖性硬化和短程肌肉僵硬的关键保护作用，指出预接触着地策略和离心力量训练是损伤预防的基石。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical commentary proposes an integrative hypothesis for non-contact ACL injuries, emphasizing the critical protective roles of pre-contact hamstring tension, titin's calcium-dependent stiffening, and short-range muscle stiffness. This reinforces that in ACL injury prevention, you should focus on landing strategies and eccentric strength training.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Effects of Exercise Training on the Metabolic Cost of Walking in Health and Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 27 studies (N=1177) found chronic physical exercise training improved the metabolic cost of walking (g = 0.40, p = 0.001) in healthy adults (g = 0.49, p = 0.001), but not significantly in stroke patients (g = 0.24, p = 0.065).
items.curatedReason: 慢性运动训练确实能改善健康成年人的步行代谢成本 (g = 0.40)，因此，在这一群体中将其作为提升步行经济性的策略是可靠的。但在卒中患者中效果不显著 (g = 0.24, p = 0.065)，不要对这类患者抱有过高期望。
items.titleZh: 运动训练对健康和疾病人群步行代谢成本影响的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 27 项研究（N=1177）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，慢性运动训练可改善健康成年人的步行代谢成本（g = 0.40, p = 0.001），其中健康个体效果显著（g = 0.49, p = 0.001），但卒中患者效果不显著（g = 0.24, p = 0.065）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Chronic exercise training reliably improves the metabolic cost of walking in healthy adults (g = 0.40), making it a sound strategy for improving walking economy in this population. However, the effect isn't significant in stroke patients (g = 0.24, p = 0.065), so temper your expectations for this group.
items.limitation: 纳入的神经系统疾病研究样本量较小，尤其是多发性硬化和帕金森病仅各一项，限制了结论在这些人群中的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The included neurological studies had small sample sizes, particularly only one for MS and one for Parkinson's, limiting generalizability to these populations.

items.title: Modality-specific, deficit-targeted exercise prescriptions for physical function in sarcopenia and frailty: a network meta-analysis
items.summary: A network meta-analysis of 61 RCTs (N=3706) found multicomponent training with resistance training provided the most comprehensive benefits for functional mobility, while elastic band resistance training was most effective for handgrip strength (MD = 1.95 kg, 95% CI: 1.13 to 2.76) with moderate certainty.
items.curatedReason: 这项网络荟萃分析指出，包含阻力训练的多组分训练在改善老年肌少症和衰弱患者的功能活动方面提供最全面的益处。在设计你的康复方案时，应优先考虑结合弹性带和器械的个体化阻力训练。
items.titleZh: 肌少症和衰弱患者身体功能的特定模式、针对性运动处方：一项网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 61 项随机对照试验（N=3706）的网络荟萃分析发现，包含阻力训练的多组分训练对功能活动提供了最全面的益处，而弹性带阻力训练对握力最有效（平均差 = 1.95 kg, 95% CI: 1.13 至 2.76），证据确定性为中等。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network meta-analysis indicates that multicomponent training, including resistance training, provides the most comprehensive benefits for improving functional mobility in older adults with sarcopenia and frailty. When designing rehabilitation programs, prioritize individualized resistance training incorporating elastic bands and machines.
items.limitation: 多组分训练对功能活动益处的证据确定性为低，弹性带和器械阻力训练的证据确定性分别为中等和低，提示仍需更多高确定性研究。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of evidence for multicomponent training's benefits on functional mobility is low, and for elastic band and machine-based resistance training, it is moderate and low, respectively, suggesting a need for more high-certainty research.

items.title: A multimodal non-fatiguing recovery strategy improves neuromuscular restoration and attenuates inflammatory and oxidative stress responses following a standardized football match: a randomized crossover study
items.summary: A randomized crossover study in 20 male semi-professional football players found a multimodal non-fatiguing recovery strategy (low-intensity cycling, foam rolling, percussive therapy) showed smaller post-recovery declines in peak force (−7.5% vs −14.3% in passive recovery) and other neuromuscular outcomes, along with smaller increases in muscle damage and inflammatory markers.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机交叉研究支持多模式非疲劳性恢复策略能改善足球比赛后的神经肌肉功能恢复并减轻炎症/氧化应激，优于被动恢复。你在运动员赛后恢复中，可考虑采用包括低强度骑行、泡沫轴和震动疗法的组合方案。
items.titleZh: 多模式非疲劳性恢复策略改善标准化足球比赛后的神经肌肉恢复并减轻炎症和氧化应激反应：一项随机交叉研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 20 名半专业男足球运动员进行的随机交叉研究发现，多模式非疲劳性恢复策略（低强度骑行、泡沫轴、震动疗法）在比赛后表现出较小的峰值力下降（-7.5% 对被动恢复的 -14.3%）及其他神经肌肉结果改善，并伴随肌肉损伤和炎症标志物更小的增加。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized crossover study supports that a multimodal non-fatiguing recovery strategy improves neuromuscular restoration and attenuates inflammatory/oxidative stress responses after football matches, superior to passive recovery. For athlete post-match recovery, consider a combined approach including very low-intensity cycling, foam rolling, and percussive therapy.
items.limitation: 研究未进行前瞻性注册，且主要关注短期恢复效果，对长期影响尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study was not prospectively registered and focused primarily on short-term recovery, with long-term effects remaining unclear.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Impact of malnutrition and protein-enriched oral nutrition on early recovery after fragility fractures in older adults: the NuTra trial
items.summary: A single-center RCT (N=218) found that a protein-enriched diet during acute hospital stay did not significantly improve in-hospital medical complications, surgical site infections, or functional mobility at discharge in older adults with fragility fractures at nutritional risk.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照研究显示，在急性住院期间为营养风险高的老年脆性骨折患者提供富含蛋白质的饮食，并未带来短期并发症或功能恢复的明显益处。这提示你营养干预应作为更广泛的长期康复策略的一部分，而不应仅限于急性期。
items.titleZh: 营养不良和富含蛋白质的口服营养对老年脆性骨折患者早期恢复的影响：NuTra 试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心随机对照试验（N=218）发现，在急性住院期间为营养风险高的老年脆性骨折患者提供富含蛋白质的饮食，并未显著改善院内医疗并发症、手术部位感染或出院时的功能活动度。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT shows that protein-enriched diets for older adults with fragility fractures at nutritional risk during acute hospitalization did not yield significant short-term benefits in complications or functional recovery. This suggests nutritional interventions should be part of broader, long-term rehabilitation strategies, not just limited to the acute phase.
items.limitation: 研究是单中心进行，且营养干预仅限于急性住院期，可能不足以观察到长期或更复杂的康复益处。
items.limitationEn: The study was single-center, and the nutritional intervention was limited to acute hospitalization, which might be insufficient to observe long-term or more complex rehabilitation benefits.

items.title:
Effectiveness of physical, psychological, and alternative interventions for post-COVID-19 condition: a systematic review
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A systematic review of 27 RCTs (N=1998) found supervised cardiopulmonary rehabilitation and multimodal exercise consistently improved cardiorespiratory fitness and walking capacity in adults with post-COVID-19 condition, while CBT reduced fatigue and concentration complaints.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述发现，监督下的心肺康复和多模式运动训练可持续改善新冠后遗症患者的心肺适应能力和步行能力。这基本坐实了运动疗法作为新冠后遗症一线干预的地位，你在实践中应积极推荐。
items.titleZh: 针对新冠后遗症的物理、心理和替代干预措施的有效性：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 27 项随机对照试验（N=1998）的系统综述发现，监督下的心肺康复和多模式运动训练持续改善了新冠后遗症成年患者的心肺适应能力和步行能力，而认知行为疗法减轻了疲劳和注意力不集中症状。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review finds that supervised cardiopulmonary rehabilitation and multimodal exercise consistently improve cardiorespiratory fitness and walking capacity in post-COVID-19 patients. This strongly establishes exercise therapy as a first-line intervention for post-COVID-19 condition, which you should actively recommend in practice.
items.limitation: 纳入研究普遍存在方法学局限（小样本、未盲法、随访期短），导致结果的异质性，未来仍需更大规模、高质量的 RCT。
items.limitationEn: Included studies generally had methodological limitations (small samples, unblinding, short follow-ups), leading to heterogeneity in results, and larger, high-quality RCTs are still needed.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Principles for the use of outcome-based approaches to accreditation
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) Accreditation Committee published principles for outcome-based accreditation approaches, aiming to guide accreditation authorities in fostering continuous quality improvement and public safety in health practitioner education, and addressing workforce challenges.
items.curatedReason: 当你在澳洲考虑教育项目或执业认可时，请关注这些原则，它们强调以成果为导向的教育模式，这可能影响你未来的职业发展和教育选择。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构：成果导向型认证方法使用原则
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 (AHPRA) 认证委员会发布了成果导向型认证方法原则，旨在指导认证机构在卫生从业者教育中促进持续质量改进和公共安全，并应对劳动力挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: AHPRA has published "Principles for the use of outcome-based approaches to accreditation," guiding accreditation bodies in using outcome-based approaches in education programs to foster continuous quality improvement and public safety. This directly impacts PT education accreditation and curriculum development in Australia, and you should monitor its implementation.

items.title: Sexual harassment experienced by nurses in a spinal cord injury rehabilitation center.
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey of 48 nursing professionals in a SCI rehabilitation center found 87.5% reported patient-perpetrated sexual harassment within the past 12 months, with verbal harassment (87.5%) being most prevalent.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了脊髓损伤康复中心护士遭受患者性骚扰的普遍性（87.5%），尤其以言语性骚扰最为常见，提醒你关注执业环境安全。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤康复中心护士遭受患者性骚扰的经历
items.summaryZh: 一项对脊髓损伤康复中心 48 名护理人员的横断面调查显示，87.5% 的受访者在过去 12 个月内曾遭受患者的性骚扰，其中言语性骚扰最为普遍（87.5%）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals the high prevalence (87.5%) of patient-perpetrated sexual harassment against nurses in SCI rehabilitation centers, with verbal harassment being most common. It highlights the importance of addressing workplace safety in practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为单一中心、小样本（n=48）的横断面调查，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center, small-sample (n=48) cross-sectional survey, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: "It's important, but at a cost…": healthcare professionals and people with aphasia describe what influences use of a novel, digital communication aid.
items.summary: Interviews with 10 HCPs and 3 PWA revealed that while HCPs value digital communication aids like the Aphasia App for person-centered care, systemic constraints within the healthcare system limit their adoption and use.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了在临床实践中推广数字沟通辅助工具（如失语症App）的障碍，虽然医护人员认可其价值，但系统性支持不足。你在考虑引入新技术时，应关注机构层面的变革和协作，而不仅仅是工具本身。
items.titleZh: 医疗专业人员和失语症患者对新型数字沟通辅助工具使用影响因素的描述
items.summaryZh: 对 10 名医护人员和 3 名失语症患者的访谈显示，尽管医护人员认可失语症 App 等数字沟通辅助工具在以人为本护理中的价值，但医疗系统内的限制阻碍了其采用和使用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights barriers to adopting digital communication aids like the Aphasia App in clinical practice. While HCPs value such tools, systemic support is lacking. When considering new tech, focus on organizational change and collaboration, not just the tool itself.
items.limitation: 本研究仅访谈了 10 名医护人员和 3 名失语症患者，样本量较小，且聚焦于特定 App，可能不具备广泛代表性。
items.limitationEn: This study interviewed only 10 HCPs and 3 PWA, representing a small sample size focused on a specific app, potentially limiting generalizability.

items.title: Appraisals of life transition events and associations with quality of life at 3- and 12-months post-discharge following spinal cord injury.
items.summary: A longitudinal observational study of adults with SCI (n=47 at 3 months, n=39 at 12 months) found that more positive appraisals of the impact and coping with life transition events were consistently associated with better quality of life post-discharge.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，脊髓损伤患者在出院后 12 个月内对生活转折事件的积极评价和应对能力，与更好的生活质量相关。你在临床中应更关注患者对康复进展的"主观意义"，并支持其自我效能。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤患者出院后 3 和 12 个月生活转折事件评价与生活质量的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项针对脊髓损伤成年患者（3 个月随访 n=47，12 个月随访 n=39）的纵向观察研究发现，出院后对生活转折事件影响和应对能力的积极评价，与更好的生活质量持续相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that positive appraisals and coping abilities regarding life transition events are associated with better quality of life in SCI patients up to 12 months post-discharge. In practice, prioritize understanding patients' "subjective meaning" of recovery progress and supporting their self-efficacy.
items.limitation: 本研究的样本量较小（3 个月随访 n=47，12 个月 n=39），且为观察性研究，无法建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (n=47 at 3 months, n=39 at 12 months) and is observational, preventing causal inferences.

items.title: Psychometric Evaluation of the Parental Education in Physiotherapy Scale: A Brief Measure of Family-Centered Educational Practices in Pediatric Physiotherapy.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study (N=310) evaluated the psychometric properties of the 8-item, 3-factor Parental Education in Physiotherapy (PEP) scale, confirming its excellent fit (CFI = 1.000, RMSEA = 0.011) and adequate internal consistency for assessing family-centered educational practices in pediatric physiotherapy.
items.curatedReason: 本研究验证了儿童物理治疗师亲子教育量表 (PEP) 的良好心理测量学特性，提供了一个评估以家庭为中心的教育实践的有效工具。这有助于你反思和改进在儿科物理治疗中的家庭教育策略。
items.titleZh: 亲子物理治疗教育量表心理测量学评估：儿科物理治疗中以家庭为中心的教育实践简明测量工具
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究（N=310）评估了由 8 个条目和 3 个因子组成的亲子物理治疗教育量表（PEP）的心理测量学特性，证实其具有出色的拟合度（CFI = 1.000, RMSEA = 0.011）和足够的内部一致性，可用于评估儿科物理治疗中以家庭为中心的教育实践。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study validates the Parental Education in Physiotherapy (PEP) scale, providing an effective tool to assess family-centered educational practices. This can help you reflect on and improve your family education strategies in pediatric physical therapy.
items.limitation: 研究样本仅限于西班牙的物理治疗师，结果可能不完全适用于其他文化或医疗系统背景。
items.limitationEn: The study sample was limited to physiotherapists in Spain, and the results may not be fully applicable to other cultural or healthcare system contexts.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Assessment of audiovestibular function in patients with psoriatic arthritis: a cross-sectional controlled study
items.summary: A cross-sectional controlled study of 35 PsA patients and 35 controls found PsA patients had higher hearing thresholds (p ≤ 0.001) and lower WRS (p ≤ 0.001). They also showed lower cVEMP amplitudes and vHIT VOR gains, and a higher prevalence of abnormal caloric unilateral weakness (34.3% vs no controls, p ≤ 0.001).
items.curatedReason: 本研究发现银屑病关节炎患者存在亚临床听觉和前庭功能异常，且与疾病活动度相关。这提示你在评估这类患者时，除了常规的肌肉骨骼系统，也应考虑筛查其听觉和前庭功能，以便早期识别并转诊。
items.titleZh: 银屑病关节炎患者听觉前庭功能评估：一项横断面对照研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 35 名银屑病关节炎患者和 35 名对照组的横断面对照研究发现，银屑病关节炎患者的听力阈值较高（p ≤ 0.001）、言语识别得分较低（p ≤ 0.001）。他们还表现出较低的 cVEMP 波幅和 vHIT VOR 增益，以及异常冷热试验单侧减弱的患病率更高（34.3% 对照组中未出现，p ≤ 0.001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found subclinical auditory and vestibular abnormalities in psoriatic arthritis patients, correlated with disease activity. When assessing these patients, consider screening for audiovestibular function in addition to musculoskeletal issues to facilitate early identification and referral.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立银屑病关节炎与听觉/前庭功能异常之间的因果关系，且样本量相对较小（n=35）。
items.limitationEn: This study's cross-sectional design prevents establishing causality between psoriatic arthritis and audiovestibular dysfunction, and the sample size is relatively small (n=35).

items.title: Effects of integrating blood flow restriction (BFR) into sport-specific on-field training on athletic performance and physiological adaptations in team-sport athletes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 6 studies (N=102) found integrating blood flow restriction into sport-specific on-field training may improve relative mean power during 30-second cycling (MD = −0.50 W/kg, 95% CI: −0.85 to −0.15), but with low certainty of evidence and no clear benefits for other outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 将血流限制 (BFR) 纳入运动专项训练可能改善 30 秒循环的相对平均功率，但证据确定性非常低，且对其他指标没有明确益处。鉴于目前证据不足，不建议常规使用 BFR 来提升运动表现。
items.titleZh: 将血流限制 (BFR) 整合到运动专项场上训练对团队运动运动员运动表现和生理适应的影响：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 6 项研究（N=102）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，将血流限制整合到运动专项场上训练中可能改善 30 秒循环的相对平均功率（平均差 = −0.50 W/kg, 95% CI: −0.85 至 −0.15），但证据确定性较低，且对其他结局无明确益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: Integrating blood flow restriction (BFR) into sport-specific training might improve relative mean power during 30-second cycling, but the certainty of evidence is low and there are no clear benefits for other outcomes. Given the insufficient evidence, don't routinely incorporate BFR for athletic performance enhancement.
items.limitation: 纳入的研究数量少（6 篇报告，5 项独立试验），样本量小（N=102），且结果受方差假设影响，证据确定性普遍较低或非常低。
items.limitationEn: The small number of included studies (6 reports, 5 independent trials) and sample size (N=102), combined with results affected by variance assumptions, led to generally low or very low certainty of evidence.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Comparison of short-foot and toe-curl exercises on movement control during single-leg landing after ACL reconstruction: An exploratory randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: In ACLR patients, short-foot exercise (SFE) significantly reduced hip adduction excursion during single-leg landing compared to toe-curl exercise (TCE) at 6 weeks (between-group difference -6.30°, ES -1.41) and 12 weeks, suggesting SFE facilitates earlier improvement in frontal-plane movement control.
items.curatedReason: ACLR 术后康复中，短足运动（SFE）在改善额状面运动控制方面的效果优于足趾卷曲运动（TCE），效应量（ES -1.41）相当可观。这意味着你可以优先将 SFE 纳入 ACLR 术后康复方案，尤其是在早期阶段。
items.titleZh: ACL 重建术后单腿着陆运动控制中短足运动与足趾卷曲运动的比较：一项探索性随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 在 ACLR 患者中，与足趾卷曲运动（TCE）相比，短足运动（SFE）在 6 周时显著降低了单腿着陆时的髋关节内收偏移（组间差异 -6.30°，效应量 -1.41），并在 12 周时保持较低水平，提示 SFE 有助于早期改善额状面运动控制。
items.curatedReasonEn: For ACLR rehabilitation, Short-Foot Exercise (SFE) is superior to Toe-Curl Exercise (TCE) in improving frontal-plane movement control, with a substantial effect size (ES -1.41). This means you can prioritize SFE in ACLR postoperative rehabilitation protocols, particularly in the early stages.
items.limitation: 这是一项多中心探索性 RCT，虽然结果显著，但样本量相对较小（38 人），可能限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This is a multicenter exploratory RCT; while results are significant, the relatively small sample size (38 participants) may limit generalizability.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Construct validity and intrasession intra-rater reliability of the stair and step tests in individuals with multiple sclerosis.
items.summary: In 100 MS patients, both the Stair Test (ICC 0.997) and Step Test (ICC 0.955) showed excellent test-retest reliability and strong construct validity with other mobility scales. These tests offer a practical, fast, and low-fatigue solution for monitoring mobility in MS.
items.curatedReason: 针对多发性硬化症（MS）患者，Stair Test 和 Step Test 表现出优异的信度、测量精度和结构效度。这些测试快速、低疲劳，可以作为你临床实践中监测 MS 患者移动能力的实用工具。
items.titleZh: 多发性硬化症患者的爬楼梯和台阶测试的结构效度及会内评价者内信度。
items.summaryZh: 在 100 名多发性硬化症患者中，爬楼梯测试（ICC 0.997）和台阶测试（ICC 0.955）均显示出优异的重测信度，并与其他移动量表具有强结构效度。这些测试为监测多发性硬化症患者的移动能力提供了实用、快速且不易疲劳的解决方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: For individuals with Multiple Sclerosis (MS), the Stair Test and Step Test demonstrate excellent reliability, measurement precision, and construct validity. These tests are quick and low-fatigue, making them practical tools for you to monitor mobility in MS patients in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 研究样本量为 100 名 MS 患者，结果的广泛适用性可能需要更大规模的多中心研究进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a sample size of 100 MS patients, and the broad applicability of results may require further validation in larger, multicenter studies.
